The Opportunity

This isn’t just a Sales Development role — it’s your chance to be the engine of Sitetracker’s pipeline growth during a high-impact period. As a French-speaking Senior Sales Development Representative, you’ll address the critical business need of generating a consistent, high-quality pipeline in our EMEA region. With increased investment and focus on international expansion, your efforts will directly influence revenue growth and market penetration in this dynamic, fast-paced environment. You’ll be stepping into a role with visibility, autonomy, and the support to shape how Sitetracker connects with prospective customers across London, Spain, and beyond. If you’re driven by the challenge of building scalable outbound strategies and crave the opportunity to make a measurable difference — this is it.


What You’ll Do

As a Senior SDR, you’ll play a pivotal front-line role in Sitetracker’s sales ecosystem. You’ll consistently generate high-quality leads and pipeline through thoughtful, targeted outreach, becoming a true partner to our account executives and a trusted voice to our prospects. This isn’t a “smile and dial” environment — it’s a career-defining opportunity to take ownership of your region and make strategic decisions about where and how we go to market. You’ll collaborate with marketing and sales leadership to refine messaging, run account-based plays, and experiment with new channels and approaches. Your success will be measured not just by volume, but by the business value of the opportunities you surface. In short, you won’t just be booking meetings — you’ll be driving real, scalable impact.


The Skills You’ll Have


1. Operational Discipline & Consistency

  • Build and follow a consistent daily rhythm to drive pipeline generation and CRM hygiene
  • Use time-blocking and focused outreach methods to hit high-volume targets
  • Demonstrate follow-through on multi-touch outreach campaigns with measurable results
  • Log activity and outcomes meticulously to create visibility and enable coaching
  • Maintain clean Salesforce records and proactively flag blockers or risks

2. Outbound Prospecting Excellence

  • Drive outbound pipeline creation using a mix of phone, email, and social touchpoints
  • Execute persona-driven messaging that resonates across geographies
  • Customize outreach for Tier 1 accounts and apply insights to scale for Tier 2/3
  • Partner with AEs on account strategy to deliver personalized outreach sequences
  • Track and analyze response patterns to iterate and improve outreach effectiveness

3. Resilience & Mindset

  • Maintain momentum and positivity through high-rejection outreach environments
  • Rebound from challenges by leveraging data and coaching for continuous improvement
  • Lean into discomfort and drive impact during uncertain or ambiguous situations
  • Build mental stamina and structure that sustains performance over time

4. Target & KPI Accountability

  • Consistently exceed quota and activity metrics through focused execution
  • Demonstrate a strong sense of ownership and pride in hitting and surpassing goals
  • Adjust approach based on pipeline coverage, conversion trends, and feedback loops
  • Proactively surface opportunities to improve systems, messaging, or workflows

Within 90 Days, You’ll:

  • Ramp to full productivity with a structured, repeatable prospecting rhythm
  • Own outreach for your assigned region and collaborate closely with sales leaders
  • Deliver pipeline against monthly targets with precision and urgency
  • Demonstrate accountability through clean Salesforce tracking and proactive updates
  • Begin influencing team strategy through feedback and performance insights

Within 180 Days, You’ll:

  • Exceed pipeline goals through creative outbound strategies and consistent execution
  • Establish yourself as a trusted partner to your AE and regional sales team
  • Actively contribute to refining messaging, plays, and processes
  • Identify and overcome barriers in specific markets or verticals
  • Take initiative to lead mini-projects or best practice sharing sessions

Within 365 Days, You’ll:

  • Become a bar-raising performer, consistently hitting top quartile performance
  • Influence SDR playbooks and prospecting strategy across EMEA
  • Mentor new hires or contribute to team training and enablement
  • Partner with marketing to align messaging and drive pipeline quality
  • Position yourself for career growth into AE or leadership paths

Level Up Your Career!
 
At Kwalee, you’ll join a gaming powerhouse that boasts a mobile empire with 1.5 billion+ downloads alongside a thriving PC & Console division that has achieved numerous global chart-topping releases across Steam, Consoles, and Amazon, driving millions of Wishlists. Most recently publishing breakout hits such as The Precinct and Town to City. It’s a unique chance to bring your expertise to a global studio that dominates both the mobile, and the indie PC and Console space.
 
At Kwalee, as well as a competitive salary we also offer; Private Medical Insurance, Dental Insurance, Life Assurance, Royal London Pension, a Free On-site Gym, Dog-friendly Office, LinkedIn Learning, 25 holiday days + bank holidays, and 1 day extra holiday for each year of service capped at 5.

Join The Team!

Kwalee’s Product & Growth team is looking for a Senior User Acquisition Manager to steer User Acquisition across our mobile portfolio: live hits, much-loved classics, and exciting new games looking for their big break.

We’ll shape the title around your experience, from Senior UA Manager to Lead UA Manager or even Head of UA, because it’s the impact that matters.

This role is for you if you’re a hands-on UA leader who gets a real buzz from spotting where the next profitable pound of spend is hiding, and proving it. You’ll grow a team of UA Managers who proudly own their games, and bring an investor’s eye to the whole portfolio so every game and every campaign earns its place in the spotlight.

This role is based on-site 5 days per week at our Leamington Spa studio, where our daily in-office collaboration fuels creativity and innovation. 


What You’ll Do:
  • Steer portfolio UA. Set the UA strategy across our games and channels, and put every pound where it works hardest.
  • Grow a brilliant team. Lead and coach our UA Managers, give each of them clear ownership of their games, and help them do the best work of their careers.
  • Unlock profitable scale. Find the games ready to grow faster, and move quickly when something isn’t paying back.
  • Keep targets sharp. Work with our analytics team on LTV and ROAS targets, and bring a healthy challenge when the numbers don’t add up.
  • Power the creative engine. Partner with our creative and analytics teams so every game has a steady flow of fresh ads being tested, learned from, and scaled.
  • Give new games a fair shot. Run clean, consistent market tests for our new game ideas so we can spot the winners early.
  • Be the UA voice in our game teams. Share what the market is telling us with producers, product, and monetisation, and turn game improvements into more growth.
  • Build great partnerships. Work closely with ad networks and platforms, and keep exploring new channels

    • What You’ll Own:

    Profitable growth across our portfolio. You’ll be the go-to owner of how our games grow: spotting opportunities first, catching dips early, keeping targets sharp, and helping your team stay on top of every game they own.

    How we’ll celebrate your success:
  • Profitable spend and installs at or above target payback
  • ROAS and payback against target
  • UA contribution to profit across the portfolio
  • How quickly budget moves to the best opportunities
  • A happy, growing UA team

    • What We’re Looking For:
    Essential
  • Senior UA experience in mobile games, with F2P titles you’ve scaled profitably across ad networks and social channels.
  • Experience leading or mentoring UA Managers.
  • A strong grasp of ROAS, payback, LTV and cohort analysis, and of measurement in today’s privacy- first world.
  • A love of creative testing, and a feel for what makes an ad win on different channels.
  • Great commercial judgement: you can explain every budget decision in pounds.
  • Happy getting hands-on with campaigns, spreadsheets and BI tools.
  • A clear, confident communicator who brings people along with evidence.
    • Desirable
  • Hybrid-casual or puzzle mobile game experience is a big plus.
    • Why Kwalee?
    • Generous Holiday: Start with 25 days of annual leave, plus bank holidays. You'll also earn an extra day for every year of service, up to 5 years!
    • Flexible Working: We offer core hours that allow you to work flexibly around your life, and a bank of 'Work From Home' days to use when you need them.
    • Health Cover: Private medical cover, life assurance, a solid pension plan, and cover for dental and optical care.
    • Recharge: Take advantage of our on-site gym and a supportive atmosphere that prioritises your wellbeing.
    • Free Food & Drink: Fuel your day with unlimited free snacks and drinks.
    • Gaming Goodies: Receive Steam codes for all our game releases!
    • Dog-Friendly Office: Bring your furry friend to our vibrant, fun office.
    • Office Location: Leamington Spa office location, with free parking and electric charging stations.
    • Merch & Events: Get exclusive Kwalee merch, enjoy fun seasonal events, and stay informed with regular town halls.
    • Growth & Learning: Full access to LinkedIn Learning to support your continuous professional development.
     
    Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion
     
    At Kwalee, we take pride in being an equal opportunity employer, where we believe that diversity and inclusion are essential to driving creativity. We are committed to creating a safe, welcoming, and supportive environment where everyone can thrive.
     
    Our culture is built on celebrating the diverse voices of our team members, fuelling innovation and strengthening our connection to our players. We are dedicated to advancing equity, diversity, and inclusion across all areas of life, including age, disability, gender identity, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, and sexual orientation.
     
    We recognise the importance of self-development, career progression, and well-being in retaining our talented team. At Kwalee, we celebrate individuality and encourage everyone to bring their authentic selves to work.

Join The Team!

Kwalee’s Product & Growth team is looking for a Senior Product Manager to shape what comes next in our live games: what we change, why, and what it will earn.

You’ll team up with our Executive Producers: they lead how we build, you lead what we build and why, and together you make our games better and better. 

We’ll match the title to your experience. This role is for you if you’re a product leader who loves living in player data, forming bold hypotheses about retention, engagement, and monetisation, running clean experiments, and turning results into confident decisions.


This role is based onsite 5 days per week at our Leamington Spa studio, where our daily in-office collaboration fuels creativity and innovation. 


What You’ll Do:
  • Understand the games inside out. Know the key numbers for each game, find the biggest opportunities in retention, engagement, economy, and monetisation, and size them.
  • Start with a hypothesis. Turn every opportunity into a clear hypothesis with a success metric, so every feature ships with a purpose.
  • Run experiments that decide. Design A/B tests with our product analysts, read them with an open mind, and decide together with the producer what ships next.
  • Shape the roadmap. Build and prioritise the game roadmap with the Executive Producer, ranked by the value it will create.
  • Connect growth and product. Bring what UA and creative learn about our players into the games, and work with monetisation on the best player experience.
  • Grow the product craft. Guide our product analysts and help set how we do product across the portfolio.
  • Spot tomorrow’s hits. Bring a product view to our most promising new games as they grow.

    • What You’ll Own:

    Great product decisions and the extra player value that they will create in our biggest games.

    You’ll be the champion who ensures every big player opportunity gets a smart hypothesis, a clear experiment, and a place on the roadmap.

    How we’ll celebrate your success:
  • Growth in LTV and profit from product changes.

Farfetch is a leading global marketplace for the luxury fashion industry, connecting customers in over 190 countries with items from more than 50 countries and over 1,400 of the world’s best brands and charming boutiques from around the world. Farfetch opens a world of luxury for endless expressions of style, delivering a truly unique shopping experience and access to the most extensive selection of luxury on a global marketplace. 

LONDON
Our London office is located in Old Street, London’s tech hub, and is home to a wide range of teams. Our open space is ideal for collaborative work and sharing ideas. We also have a large outdoor terrace, which is the perfect spot to have a team lunch or host events.

COMMERICAL
We're partnering with global brands and the most influential and renowned boutique curators to bring our customers an unrivalled range of fashion to empower their individuality. We’re relationship builders, we’re solution finders and we’re analysts. We work with all areas of the FARFETCH business to improve our social and environmental impact while delivering business success. We want to empower our consumers to buy better, improve our operational footprint, and explore new business models that improve our impact. 

THE ROLE
The Merchandise Planning & Analytics team supports the growth of key supply channels and brand partnerships on FARFETCH through commercial planning and data-driven insights.
As a Merchandise Planning & Analytics Analyst, you will support the team in analysing business performance, identifying opportunities to optimise supply and maximising sales. You will contribute to pre-season planning and in-season trading, while developing analytical tools and processes to support better commercial decision-making.
Working closely with colleagues across Brand Partnerships, Business Development, Online Merchandising, Marketing, Operations, Product and Business Insights, you will help translate data into actionable insights and recommendations.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

Analytics

  • Analyse sales, stock and demand performance across brands, channels, regions, categories and products, identifying key trends and commercial opportunities.

  • Produce actionable insights and recommendations to optimise supply, improve product availability and maximise sales.

  • Develop and maintain dashboards, reports and analytical tools, working with BI and other technical teams to improve business visibility.

  • Support analysis of key commercial initiatives, including markdown optimisation, next-day delivery and exclusive products.

  • Present findings through regular trade meetings, business reviews and project updates.

  • Support with ad-hoc analysis and requests from senior management and business development

    • Planning

  • Support Merchandise Planning & Analytics managers in pre-season planning for key brand partners, using historical performance and demand trends to inform supply and assortment recommendations.

  • Refresh and maintain sales forecasting and planning models, supporting target setting and scenario analysis.

  • Monitor sales and stock performance against targets and forecasts, identifying risks and opportunities.

  • Identify supply opportunities and recommend actions to improve product availability and maximise sales.

  • Support ongoing forecasting and planning updates, contributing to the development of more effective planning models and processes


    • WHO YOU ARE

  • Collaborative, flexible and approachable, with pride in the quality of your work and an understanding that how you work is just as important as what you deliver.

  • Previous experience in Merchandise Planning, Buying, Demand or Supply Planning, Analytics or Consulting, ideally within the fashion or luxury industry.

  • An understanding of the fashion and luxury industry and its commercial drivers.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience in data analysis using large data sets .

  • Commercially minded, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.

data.description:
About Exa

Exa is an applied AI research lab organizing the entire web for AI. Agents don't search like people do. They ask long, complex questions and need clean, accurate, real-time answers. So we train our own retrieval models and index hundreds of billions of webpages, giving agents grounded, cited answers instead of stale training data.

And it's working. We've grown about 10x a year for three years, to more than $100M in annualized revenue and 2B+ requests a month from 200K+ teams. HubSpot, monday.com, Revolut, Firefox, Cognition, Cursor and OpenRouter all build on Exa. We raised a $250M Series C at a $2.2B valuation, led by a16z with Benchmark, Lightspeed, NVIDIA Ventures and Y Combinator.

If you want to build core technology that's used every day, help build a generational company, and shape the revenue engine behind it, come join us.

About the role

Exa is hiring a Senior Field Operations Manager for EMEA, based in our new London office, to be the go-to partner for our EMEA sales leader, AEs, SDRs, partners and field engineers as the region grows from a handful of people into a full team.

You’ll bring our GTM operations and programs to EMEA, partnering with our Head of Revenue Programs to decide what we keep, what we localize and what we build new for the region’s markets.

You’ll be a swiss army knife across process, change management, light deal desk, insights and tools, with the relationships and judgment to tie it all together.

If you’ve helped build ops in a new region and you love being close to the field, we’d love to talk!

What you'll do

You'll lean hard on AI across all of this. We expect AI to do much of the reporting, drafting and checking, so your time goes to the field and the conversations only a person can have.

  • Be the person our EMEA sales leader and team go to first. Listen for what matters to them, flag it, help them prioritize, and turn their problems into programs that stick.

  • Stay really close to our EMEA AEs, SDRs, partners and field engineers. Know what’s working and what’s not, and work with our Insights team to spot patterns early, before they show up in the numbers.

  • Roll out every change in EMEA, localized for our markets. Think through what each change will affect, and give each one a clear why, a playbook, training and a check-in on whether it stuck.

  • Run EMEA’s operating rhythm: weekly pipeline and forecast reviews, QBR-style reviews and planning inputs, with decisions and follow-ups tracked.

  • Help EMEA deals move through pricing, quoting and approvals with our US deal desk, Finance and Legal, including EMEA specifics like VAT, GDPR and local entities.

  • Take our operations and programs from launch to running smoothly in EMEA, and adapt them to the region’s markets, languages and buying norms.

  • Partner with our AMER Field Ops Manager on SDR process, and make it work for our EMEA SDR team.

  • Get sellers up to speed on our tools and how each one fits into how we work with buyers, and help each seller set up a day that works for them.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years in RevOps, sales ops or a similar GTM role at a B2B tech company, where you’ve done a bit of everything, from process and forecasting to deal support and reporting.

  • You’ve supported EMEA sellers and know how buying, contracting and selling differ across markets like UK and Ireland, DACH, France, the Nordics and Benelux.

  • You’re a builder and a doer who loves to optimize and organize. You’ve built processes and programs your team actually used, kept them running, and made them better.

  • You see how the whole GTM machine fits together, including where sales and field engineering meet. You think through the downstream impact of a change before it ships.

  • You’re AI-first and fluent in Exa and AI assistants like Claude, Devin and GrokBot. Our stack changes all the time, so you get up to speed fast on every tool, in the UI and through MCP, and you know when a moment calls for a human conversation instead.

  • You’re hungry, humble and curious, and change energizes you. You build trust fast, explain a change clearly to a room of reps or a VP, and you’re comfortable telling people what they need to hear.

Nice to have

  • You were part of the founding RevOps or GTM ops team in a new region.

  • You’ve worked closely with a US-based HQ across time zones.

  • You’ve worked at a usage or consumption-based company.

  • You speak a second European language.

Logistics

  • Based in our London office (hybrid), with occasional travel to our US HQs in NY and SF.

Exa is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related conditions, criminal histories consistent with applicable law, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

Compensation: £120K – £165K • Offers Equity

Ouvert en 2015 à Bordeaux, le Spa Dans le Noir ? propose une expérience de bien-être inédite, vécue dans l’obscurité totale.

Ce concept unique invite à redécouvrir ses sensations et à vivre le soin autrement, en se reconnectant pleinement à son corps et à ses émotions. Les soins sont réalisés par des praticiens mal ou non-voyants, dont le toucher expert offre une approche profondément humaine et sensorielle du massage.

Dans le cadre de notre développement, nous recherchons un(e) stagiaire Assistant(e) Spa Manager pour notre Spa de Bordeaux à partir de décembre 2026 ou janvier 2027.

Vos missions

En tant qu’Assistant(e) Spa Manager, vous serez un véritable soutien opérationnel et managérial. Vos responsabilités incluront :

Gestion & Organisation

  • Assister le gérant dans le management quotidien et l’organisation du Spa.

  • Veiller au respect des protocoles de soin et au bon déroulement des prestations.

  • Assurer la gestion des plannings, des heures de l’équipe et réaliser le reporting mensuel aux RH.

  • Organiser les remplacements en cas d'absence de praticiens.

  • Contribuer à la gestion des stocks, des commandes et du suivi logistique.

Accueil & Expérience Client

  • Accueillir les clients, gérer les rendez-vous et les accompagner durant leur parcours sensoriel.

  • Être garant(e) de la qualité de l’expérience client et des valeurs inclusives de Dans le Noir ?

  • Participer activement à la vente de prestations, de produits cosmétiques et de produits dérivés.

  • Prendre part à la préparation et à l’expédition des commandes (emballage, envoi postal).

Événementiel & Opérations

  • Participer à l'organisation de journées événementielles (massages en entreprise, opérations spéciales).

  • Accompagner les praticiens mal et non-voyants lors des prestations en dehors de l'entreprise.

  • Veiller à la propreté du Spa et coordonner les interventions techniques si nécessaire.

Vos compétences

Vous préparez un diplôme dans l’un des cursus suivants :

  • Gestion / Management de Spa

  • Hôtellerie-Restauration (option Spa / Wellness)

Who we are

Lemrock builds the infrastructure of agentic commerce.

Tomorrow, consumers won't just buy on e-commerce websites. They will discover, compare and purchase directly inside conversational AI interfaces like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and a growing long tail of specialized AI assistants.

For brands, this is a major shift: if they are not present in these environments, they become invisible.

Our mission: enable any brand to exist, sell and distribute in this new channel.

We raised a €7M seed round (the first in Europe on this market), with Jean-Baptiste Rudelle, founder of Criteo, on our board, and the Bpifrance DeepTech label.

Today, Lemrock is already:

  • 100M+ conversations per month

  • 150+ brand clients

  • a $100B market structuring at high speed

Context

You'll join a tight-knit team with high product standards and direct access to production deployment: our models are tested in real-world conditions, with several million users each month, with very short cycles between prototyping, integration and deployment.

In this context, you'll work on the next generation of agentic and recommendation systems: building the pipelines, agents, and models that sit at the core of our product.

Your Mission

Your goal is to build and scale the agentic infrastructure that powers Lemrock's commerce intelligence: turning raw signals into automated, self-improving systems at production scale.

Concretely, you will:

  • Analyze large-scale conversational interaction datasets (100M+ events/month) to uncover behavioral patterns, intent signals, and performance drivers.

  • Design and deploy agentic pipelines end-to-end, from data ingestion and enrichment to model orchestration, monitoring, and continuous improvement, integrated into systems exposed to millions of requests daily.

  • Build autonomous agents that keep our knowledge infrastructure accurate and current.

  • Translate insights into iteration loops in production, by updating, fine-tuning, and improving our existing recommendation and ranking algorithms with tight constraints on latency, robustness, and business outcomes.

  • Design and train new recommendation models from scratch when needed, with a focus on scalability, evaluation rigor, and deployability in real-world traffic.

Candidate Profile

  • Strong academic background (MVA, ENS, X, Central…)

  • 2+ years of experience in AI, Agentic Systems, ML / Deep Learning, statistics or NLP

  • Experience prototyping and deploying AI models into production

  • Experience with production systems (APIs, monitoring, optimization)

  • Strong interest in LLMs, recommendation and conversational systems: building agentic pipelines, agent orchestration, fine-tuning

  • Comfortable with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor)

  • Thrives in ambiguity and 0-to-1 environments

  • Fluent in English; French is a plus

Tech Stack

ML/AI (required)

  • Agentic frameworks (e.g., Langchain) and/or native SDKs like OpenAI/Anthropic

  • Observability and evaluation for LLM/agent workflows

  • Vector search, scoring, prompting, LLM orchestration

  • Hybrid recommender systems, causal inference, probabilistic models

Bonus (appreciated but not required)

  • TypeScript

  • Engineering: Docker, GCP, PostgreSQL, Redis, Vector DBs, PostHog

  • CI/CD

Why Join Us

  • Join a company in early breakout mode, already generating revenue, with a clear technological edge and strong financial backing to fuel its growth

  • Work directly with an experienced team: two repeat YC founders who've scaled product & tech before, a former strategy/innovation director (10 years in the sector), and ex-strategy consultants (McKinsey QuantumBlack, BCG)

Vision :

As a leading software-as-a-service (SaaS) provider, DiliTrust is a global company dedicated to offering an integrated suite of legal and governance products. Our vision is to digitize legal departments worldwide. With an annual growth rate of over 40% since 2020, our ambition is to become the world's leading Legal Tech company, aiming for a valuation exceeding $1 billion by 2026.

Our Impact :

From generating General Meeting reports to leveraging AI-assisted contract lifecycle management, our teams in our 8 offices across France, the US, Mexico, MEA, Germany, Spain, Italy, and Canada are the driving force behind our global success. We proudly support 2,400 customers in 64 countries, with 80% of our clientele comprising listed companies in major markets such as Europe, North America, and the Middle East.

DiliTrust has been at the forefront of Legal Tech innovation, being the first Legal Tech with AI features since 2022. The company is renowned for providing a positive and entrepreneurial work environment. We are honored to have received the "Happy at Work" and "Tech at Work" labels every year since 2019.

The role

Lini is DiliTrust's AI agent, powering Ask Lini, Risk Detector, Document Summarization, Minute Generation, and every AI capability across the suite. We are building a dedicated squad around it and are looking for the engineer who will lead it.

As Engineering Manager for the Lini AI Platform, you will report directly to the Head of Engineering and lead a squad yet to be hired, fully focused on Lini initiatives. You will own both the technical quality and the human dimension of the team, from architecture decisions to individual growth plans.

A key part of the role is coordination: you sit at the intersection of ML, product, and feature engineering, and you are accountable for making those conversations productive.

We are looking for a senior engineer who grew into leadership and kept writing code (~30% of your time), while driving delivery, standards, and culture.

We also care about how you think about AI: whether you approach it as a design question as much as an engineering one, and whether you bring genuine curiosity and opinions into product conversations.

Missions :

  • Work in close collaboration with the ML team, Product Managers, and feature squads to define and ship Lini features

  • Lead code reviews, own the squad's engineering standards, and weigh in on architecture choices
  • Own delivery end-to-end: from scoping and planning to deployment and iteration, across all Lini-powered features in the DiliTrust Suite

  • Partner with the Head of Engineering on cross-squad initiatives, technical roadmap, and hiring

Requirements

  • Proven track record of owning technical decisions: architecture, scalability, code quality (not just managing the people making them)

Technical expertise :
  • Strong proficiency in Node.js / TypeScript and Vue.js 3
  • Deep background in scalable web architectures and API design

About the Role

As a Senior Data Engineer on the Financial Flows team, you will take full technical ownership of the end-to-end data pipelines, predictive models, and cloud infrastructure powering Kpler’s commodity finance analytics. You will lead the modernization of our data foundation, spearheading the migration of production services to AWS and re-architecting legacy calculation engines into clean, performant Python services. Operating at the crossroads of quantitative research and cloud infrastructure, your work will directly ensure that market participants receive real-time, mission-critical insights across global commodities markets.

  • Ingest and model complex financial datasets—including futures pricing, open interest, and trading volumes—across time-series stores and search engines like QuestDB and Elasticsearch.

  • Implement automated data validation, proactive alerting, and system monitoring to ensure market data feeds remain accurate, continuous, and fault-tolerant.

  • Deploy, maintain, and scale containerized services across Docker and Kubernetes environments using automated CI/CD pipelines and GitOps workflows.

L’histoire de Theodo et son succès
Depuis 2009, Theodo accompagne des entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux (plateforme TF1+, applications LCL Pro et France Identité Numérique) en alliant excellence technologique et approche Lean.
 
Le Groupe fédère aujourd’hui 750 Theodoers répartis dans 3 bureaux (Paris, Londres et Rabat). En forte croissance, il a généré 100 millions d’euros de chiffre d’affaires en 2025.
 
Dans ce contexte, notre dernière enquête interne a clairement fait émerger le besoin d’une communication interne plus lisible, plus régulière et mieux organisée. Pour y répondre, nous avons mené au deuxième semestre 2026 un audit de la communication interne et formulé des orientations pour la professionnaliser : une architecture, des porte-paroles, des standards pour les rituels et les annonces, une cascade d’information, de nouveaux formats et une feuille de route pour 2027. Vous prendrez le relais de ce travail. Votre rôle sera de vous approprier ces recommandations et de les mettre en œuvre avec les dirigeants, les partners et les équipes.
 
Pour fluidifier la communication au sein de l’organisation au bénéfice de la performance Groupe, la direction générale de Theodo crée un poste de Responsable / Directeur de la communication interne.

The Mission: Strategic Growth & Deep-Tech Advisory (Telecom Focus)

At Illuin Technology, we don't just "sell" software; we architect the AI future of the world’s largest organizations. As a Senior Account Executive specialized in Telecommunications, your mission is to manage a strategic portfolio of 5 to 10 major enterprise accounts within the Telco sector. You aren't just a vendor; you are a trusted advisor navigating high-stakes environments to deliver durable, multi-year partnerships with Tier-1 operators, ISPs, and infrastructure providers.

You will master a dual-track revenue model: driving multi-year licenses for our cutting-edge AI product suite while orchestrating high-impact strategic consulting projects. Your success is measured by your ability to penetrate complex telecom organizations, build C-Level intimacy, and turn technical excellence into sustainable commercial success.

Your DNA

  • The Telco Strategic Hunter: You thrive in the complexity of long sales cycles (6–12 months) specific to the telecommunications industry. You don't just wait for leads; you build account plans that map out stakeholders and influence the RFP (Appel d'Offres) before it’s even written. You have successfully answered and won major Telco RFPs in the past.

  • Industry Insider: You possess a profound understanding of the Telco landscape. You know the specific challenges of the sector—from 5G monetization and network optimization to OSS/BSS modernization and customer churn reduction—and you know how to leverage AI to address them.

  • Hybrid Commercial Profile: You are equally at home selling scalable SaaS products as you are selling high-value, bespoke strategic services (Time & Materials (T&M) and Fixed-price).

  • AI Fluent: You possess a deep cognitive curiosity for AI and IT architecture. You can hold your own in a room of Telco CTOs, CIOs, and Data Leads, translating technical capabilities into tangible business ROI.

  • The "Field" Mentality: You believe sales happen in the room, not just on Zoom. You enjoy being on the field, building relationships in person, and mastering the nuances of the Paris business ecosystem.

  • Force Multiplier: You make the team better—sharing best practices, supporting peers, and stepping in when needed. Your presence increases the effectiveness and cohesion of the entire group and helps more junior team members.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Account Orchestration: Take full ownership of a targeted portfolio. You will define the strategy to expand our footprint exclusively within the Telecommunications sector.

  • Complex RFP Management: Lead and coordinate responses to highly complex, multi-million-euro Telco RFPs. You will mobilize internal resources to craft winning proposals tailored to operators' stringent requirements.

  • Full-Cycle Execution: From cold-start qualification (MEDDIC/BANT) to complex negotiations and closing. You’ll be expertly managing all stages of the sales process.

  • C-Suite Advisory: Act as the primary point of contact for C-Level as well as B-Level stakeholders in Telco organizations, identifying pain points and aligning them with Illuin’s AI roadmap.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with our Pre-sales, Products, and Engineering teams to ensure that the "vision" sold is technically sound and perfectly delivered.

  • Pipeline Rigor: Maintain extreme discipline in your CRM and forecasting. You understand that "hope is not a strategy" and rely on data to drive your activity.

Profile Requirements

  • Track Record & RFP Mastery: 10+ years of experience in consultative sales for Large Enterprise accounts, with a mandatory, verifiable track record of responding to and winning large-scale Telco RFPs. (Be prepared to provide concrete examples/track record during the process).

  • Deep Vertical Expertise: Exceptional knowledge and an active, existing network within the Telecommunications industry. You speak the language of Telco operators flawlessly.

  • Background: Ideally coming from a high-growth Scale-Up, a specialized Telco software vendor, or a Tier-1 Digital Transformation consultancy.

  • Technical Acumen: Strong understanding of Software/SaaS models and a genuine interest in Generative AI and Data ecosystems.

  • Methodology: Mastery of enterprise sales frameworks (MEDDIC, Challenger Sale, or similar).

  • Cognitive Ability: You are comfortable with numbers, mental math for on-the-spot business cases, and complex problem-solving.

  • Languages: Native-level French and professional fluency in English.

  • Logistics: Comfortable working from our HQ in La Défense (Paris) with a 1-day-per-week remote policy.

Why Join Us ?

  • Unrivaled Tech Stack: Sell the most advanced AI solutions in the market—products that are actually in production, not just "PowerPoint AI."

  • High Stakes, High Reward: Manage 5-10 accounts where your impact is visible and your commission is uncapped based on performance.

  • Culture of Excellence: Join a team of "Doers" where the Sales function is central to the company’s trajectory.

  • Sales Case Study: A simulated account planning and pitch session to demonstrate your consultative approach and "number crunching" skills on a realistic Telco scenario.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.


Sujet de stage

Doctrine développe des workflows dédiés aux professionnels du droit pour accélérer et améliorer la gestion de leurs dossiers. Dans ce contexte, l’application permet aux utilisateurs d’uploader de nombreux types de fichiers (PDF, Word, images, etc) à partir de nombreuses sources.

L’objectif du stage est d’améliorer les outils présents dans l’application pour visualiser et manipuler ces documents. Ceci peut inclure :

  • Visualiser les PDF mais également d’autres types de documents (Word, images, etc) directement dans le navigateur, d’une manière scalable et sécurisée,
  • Ajouter plus d’options pour configurer la visualisation (zoom, recherche, orientation, etc),
  • Superposer le texte issu de l’OCR au document original afin de permettre à l’utilisateur de sélectionner et copier le texte,
  • Ajouter des fonctionnalités de découpage, fusion, et de changement d’ordre des pages,
  • Et d’autres fonctionnalités !

Ces fonctionnalités sont disponibles à travers toute l’expérience de Doctrine autour des documents privés, y compris dans l’Assistant, les dossiers collaboratifs, et les outils spécialisés tels Flow Litigate et Flow Counsel.

Le ou la stagiaire devra participer à la compréhension du besoin utilisateur autour de ces outils (en collaboration avec les équipes produit) et à la définition des solutions techniques (en collaboration avec les équipes techniques). Il ou elle rejoindra l’équipe Productivity, et participera également au chapter web (regroupement de tous les développeurs fullstack de l’entreprise).


Les à-côtés du poste 👁️
Le ou la stagiaire participera comme tous les ingénieurs à son chapter (réuni 2 fois par mois) dont le but est de :
  • Partager des connaissances entre ses membres (amélioration continue, bonnes pratiques)

    • Une aventure dans laquelle la formation et le partage des connaissances font partis du quotidien.
    • Rejoindre une entreprise avec une vie d’équipe riche et dynamique : conférences, team-buildings, déjeuner, offsite, afterwork, etc.

    Nos valeurs 🤝

    Chez Doctrine, nos 4 valeurs nous accompagnent au quotidien et dans notre ambition de faire bouger les choses.

    • Challenge the status quo : nous défendons les idées audacieuses qui contribuent à l’évolution de tout un secteur.
    • Liberty and responsibility : nous encourageons l’autonomie, l’impact de chacun·e et l’ownership.
    • Knowledge is power : l'information est au cœur de la mission de Doctrine, et nous cherchons constamment à progresser.
    • Release early, release often and listen to your customers : nous croyons au pouvoir de l’itération et à l’importance d’écouter en permanence notre marché, nos client·e·s et leurs problématiques.

    🌴 Une politique de congés flexibles

    🏋️‍♀️ Un abonnement Gymlib pour les activités sportives et bien-être

    🧘 Un accès gratuit à la plateforme d'accompagnement à la santé mentale Moka.care et un accompagnement individuel allant jusqu’à 6 séances par an

    👩‍⚕️ Une assurance santé avec Alan

    🍱 🚲 Une carte Swile pour tes tickets restaurants et ton forfait mobilité durable (66,60 euros par mois)

    💡 Des réductions et avantages négociés grâce à notre CSE via la plateforme Happypal

    Notre processus de recrutement 🚀

    • Un premier échange de 30 min avec l’un.e de nos Talent Acquisition Manager pour bien comprendre ton projet professionnel et te présenter ce qu'on construit chez Doctrine
    • Une rencontre d’1h avec ton/ta futur.e manager, pour détailler le poste et le scope de l’équipe, mais aussi répondre à toutes tes questions.

Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.

Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.

Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Vestiaire Collective is the leading global online marketplace for desirable pre-loved fashion connecting millions of buyers and sellers across the world. Our mission is to transform the fashion industry for a more sustainable future by empowering our community to promote the circular fashion movement. Vestiaire was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Paris with offices in London, Berlin, New York, Singapore, Ho Chi Minh and warehouses in Tourcoing (France), Crawley (UK), Hong Kong and Brooklyn, we combine the desirability of luxury with the trust and rigour that make buying pre-loved effortless and safe.

We currently have a diverse global team of 600 employees representing more than 50 nationalities. Our values are Activism, Transparency, Dedication and Greatness and Collective.


Data Analyst - Operations

Full-time Temporary position based in Paris.

Timeline: From December 1st 2026 until June or July 2027.

About the Role

We are looking for a Data Analyst as part of the Product Team and reporting to the Data Product Lead, and working closely with the Customer Experience & Operations Products & Tech teams.

We are seeking for someone with exceptional skills in SQL and a strong emphasis on impact assessment.

You will be defining KPIs, creating dashboards and analyzing data to generate hypotheses, targets and follow up on the impact we generate for our customers and the company.

You will advocate for data driven culture, as well objective analysis over the impact of our work.

This is a full-time, Temporary role based in our Ho Chi Minh City office.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensure the proper definition and monitoring of the team KPIs & OKRs

  • Support Customer Experience & Operations Product managers with data analysis for specific business cases.

  • Define key user actions to be tracked to ensure we are able to analyse their behaviour and make sound decisions to improve the User Experience.

  • Conduct data querying and analysis, supporting the team in providing actionable data insights that lead to measurable impact.

  • Create reports & dashboards for communicating insights with stakeholders.

  • Work on A/B test setup and analysis to validate core hypotheses and assess the impact of product changes.

  • Manage stakeholder relationships and facilitate data-driven decision-making.

Who You Are

  • Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Economics/Business (with a data focus), Engineering, or related field.

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in data & product analytics, preferably in e-commerce and operations, you adapt quickly in fast-paced environments.

  • Proficient in SQL. (Experience in Python is a plus)

  • You’re curious about AI and how it can improve your work, and keen to explore practical ways to use it in your day-to-day activities. 

  • Experienced in statistical methods and experimentation.

  • Skilled in data visualisation tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker).

  • Strong communication skills in English. 

  • A team player who is structured, detail-oriented, and thrives in a startup environment.

  • Passionate about the fashion/luxury industry.

What we offer

  • A rare chance to own two of the most important, unsolved problems at the world's leading pre-loved luxury platform — trust and desirability.

  • Proximity to our Engineering team in HCMC — ship fast, learn fast, build together.

  • The chance to shape how AI transforms authentication, fraud prevention and product imagery.

  • An international, fast-paced, mission-driven team transforming fashion toward circularity.

  • Competitive salary and bonus.

  • A meaningful job with an impact on the way people consume fashion and promote sustainability

  • Two days to help Project - reinforcing your activist journey and volunteer for an association

  • Significant investment in your learning and growth

 
 
Research indicates that people from underrepresented backgrounds—including women, people with disabilities, and other marginalized communities—often hesitate to apply for roles unless they meet every single requirement.
 
At Vestiaire Collective, we believe that talent comes in many forms, and we're committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. Your unique perspective could be exactly what our team needs, so we encourage you to apply even if you don't tick every box.
 
Vestiaire Collective is an equal opportunities employer

Founded in 2005, Diabolocom is a leading European provider of AI-first, cloud-based contact centre (CCaaS) and customer experience (CX) solutions. We combine proprietary AI technology, native telecom infrastructure, and deep CRM integrations to help businesses deliver smarter, more seamless customer experiences.

Trusted by over 400 clients, we are entering a new phase of growth, scaling our technology and accelerating our international expansion, with offices in the United States, Canada, Brazil, and the United Arab Emirates.

As part of our Cross Functional Projects team, you will work on a variety of technical and business-driven projects with a direct impact on Diabolocom's operations and growth.

You'll join a hands-on team tackling important business challenges, where pragmatism, autonomy, and fast execution are key. From developing applications and internal tools to contributing to cross-functional initiatives, you'll have the opportunity to take ownership of your work, explore different technical challenges, and see your solutions make a tangible difference.

If you enjoy building high-quality software, taking initiative, and working in a dynamic environment where you can have a real impact, this role is for you.

Software Development

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable web applications and APIs using React, Node.js (Express), PostgreSQL, and Sequelize.

Tooling & Infrastructure

  • Enhance internal tools to improve workflows and operational efficiency.

About You

Your Experience & Technical Skills

  • You have around 3 years of experience in software development. Relevant apprenticeship experience is also welcome.

  • You have experience building and maintaining web applications and APIs.

  • You are comfortable with back-end development, particularly Node.js and Express, and have experience working with PostgreSQL and Sequelize.

Build the infrastructure behind the next generation of AI-powered customer communications.

Diabolocom is building an AI-first communication platform where AI and human agents, business workflows and communication channels work together seamlessly.
As we enter our next phase of growth, we are looking for a Database Engineer (Stateful Services) to help build and operate the infrastructure foundation behind the platform.
This is a unique opportunity to work on an infrastructure environment combining carrier-grade voice systems, on-premise data centers, distributed systems and AI workloads, while helping us build the reliability and operational maturity required to support 3x growth.
You will report to the newly forming Stateful Services Lead and work closely with Engineering, SRE and Infrastructure teams to improve the reliability, scalability and evolution of our stateful systems.

Your mission

Your goal is to build, operate and improve Diabolocom’s stateful services, with a strong focus on databases and data stores.
You will help ensure that our databases and stateful systems remain highly available, reliable and performant, while evolving our infrastructure so that maintenance, upgrades and scaling can be performed safely and with minimal to no downtime.
Working closely with the Stateful Services Lead, you will take ownership of specific technical projects and contribute to the evolution of our stateful infrastructure.

You will:

  • Operate and maintain our stateful services, including PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redis, RabbitMQ and Kafka/Redpanda.
  • Contribute to the design, evolution and scaling of our database infrastructure, with 50+ PostgreSQL clusters and increasingly complex data workloads.
  • Work on projects aimed at making database maintenance, upgrades and migrations safer and less disruptive to our services.
  • Improve high availability, replication, failover, backup/restore and disaster recovery across our stateful systems.
  • Contribute to rebuilding our PostgreSQL clusters to support automatic failover between data centers and reduce the impact of maintenance operations.
  • Help improving our queueing infrastructure, including projects such as quorum-based RabbitMQ.
  • Help building and maintaining stable Redis infrastructure and improve the reliability of our stateful services.
  • Investigate and solve complex performance, scalability and reliability issues across databases and distributed systems.
  • Work closely with development teams to understand their needs, support their use of databases and help them build reliable solutions.
  • Collaborate with SRE, networking and infrastructure teams to ensure that our stateful services operate reliably within our broader infrastructure.
  • Contribute to monitoring, automation and operational practices that make our infrastructure easier and safer to operate.
  • Participate in our on-call and incident management rotation, helping diagnose and resolve production issues when needed.
  • Stay hands-on and close to the technology: you will be expected to understand how our systems work, how they fail and how to improve them.

Who we are looking for

We’re looking for a technically strong and hands-on Database Engineer who enjoys solving complex infrastructure problems and taking ownership of production systems where reliability really matters.
You have experience operating databases or stateful services in production and understand that running these systems is about much more than simply maintaining them. You know how to troubleshoot them, how they behave under load, how they fail, and how to make them more reliable as they scale.
You’ll work on specific technical projects defined with the Stateful Services Lead, while having the autonomy to investigate problems, propose solutions and contribute to technical decisions.
We care more about your technical depth, curiosity and ability to take ownership than the exact number of years of experience you have.

Must Have

  • Strong hands-on experience as a DBA, Database Engineer, SRE or similar, with solid experience in PostgreSQL.
  • Experience operating and maintaining production databases, including upgrades, migrations, replication, backups, recovery, monitoring and performance troubleshooting.
  • Good understanding of high availability and reliability for stateful systems: failover, redundancy, replication, disaster recovery and minimising downtime during maintenance.
  • Good understanding of distributed systems, including replication, consistency, fault tolerance and the challenges of operating stateful services at scale.
  • Experience working with on-premise infrastructure or a willingness and ability to quickly adapt to an on-premise/bare-metal environment.
  • Good system design skills and the ability to reason about scalability, reliability and performance.
  • Experience collaborating closely with software development teams, understanding their requirements and helping them build reliable solutions around databases and stateful services.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex production issues.
  • Strong hands-on mindset: you enjoy getting into the technical details and solving problems yourself.
  • Comfortable participating in on-call and incident management.
  • Fluent English, both written and spoken. French or other languages are a plus.

Nice to Have

Experience with some of the following:
  • ClickHouse or another complex database/data platform.
  • Kafka or Redpanda and event-streaming infrastructure.
  • RabbitMQ, particularly quorum-based configurations.
  • Redis and distributed caching.
  • Other database technologies such as Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, MySQL, Cassandra or MongoDB.
  • Advanced Linux systems administration, including processes, storage, networking and troubleshooting.
  • Bare-metal infrastructure and data-center environments.
  • Observability and monitoring of stateful systems.
  • Capacity planning, performance analysis and load testing.
  • Infrastructure automation and configuration management.
  • Incident management, root-cause analysis and post-mortem practices.

About You

  • You take ownership. When you see a reliability or scalability problem, you investigate it and work towards a solution.
  • You are genuinely technical. You like understanding how things work under the hood and are comfortable diving deep when something breaks.
  • You think in systems. You understand that databases don't operate in isolation and enjoy working across infrastructure, networking, SRE and development teams.
  • You care about reliability. You want systems that can be maintained, upgraded and scaled without putting the business at risk.
  • You are pragmatic. You can make sensible technical trade-offs in complex environments.
  • You are curious and self-driven. You learn by doing, investigate unfamiliar technologies and are comfortable figuring things out independently.
  • You enjoy solving complex problems. You like working on systems where there isn't always an obvious answer.
  • You communicate clearly. You can explain technical topics and work effectively with the teams relying on your services.
  • You are comfortable taking responsibility. You don't need to be a manager to have an impact or take the lead on a technical problem.

Why join us

  • Own critical infrastructure: your work will directly impact the reliability and scalability of Diabolocom’s platform.
  • Solve complex technical challenges: work with large-scale databases and stateful services, including PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Kafka, Redis and RabbitMQ.
  • Work on real infrastructure challenges: help improve PostgreSQL clusters, cross-data-center failover, RabbitMQ and Redis reliability.
  • Stay hands-on: spend your time solving challenging technical problems rather than managing people.
  • Learn and grow: work across databases, distributed systems, messaging and infrastructure in a diverse technical environment.
  • Work across teams: collaborate closely with Engineering, SRE and Infrastructure to build reliable systems at scale.

Recruitment Process

  1. Introductory call with Talent Acquisition (1h)
  2. Interview with Sergey, our CTO (1h)
  3. On-site System Design interview with Sergey (1h)
    Work through a technical case study and explore your system design approach.
  4. Cultural fit interview with the Team (1h)

Logistics

📍 Paris, rue de la Paix, 75002
🏢 Hybrid model: 3 days onsite / 2 days remote
💻 Equipment: choose your preferred setup (Mac/Linux + monitors)
🍽  Lunch vouchers
🚇 Navigo: 50% of the monthly pass reimbursed

One More Thing

We are not necessarily looking for someone who has already worked in this exact role or with every technology in our stack.
The strongest candidates are often engineers who have built and operated complex infrastructure, taken ownership of production systems and learned new technologies along the way.
If you enjoy solving difficult technical problems, want to work close to the infrastructure and are excited by the challenge of making stateful systems more reliable and scalable — we would love to talk.

Mission freelance de 6 mois, renouvelable par périodes de 3 ou 6 mois, dans la limite de 24 mois au total. Démarrage dès que possible, sous réserve de finalisation de la consultation.

Intervention à Saint-Denis ou à Cesson-Sévigné, avec au moins 3 jours par semaine sur site. Le travail hors site est possible à la demande du client.

Contexte de la mission

Pour un grand groupe de télécommunications qui construit une plateforme de cloud souverain, vous coordonnez les livraisons de plusieurs équipes produit qui développent des services cloud, data et IA. Vous travaillez avec les équipes chargées des fondations techniques de la plateforme pour anticiper les dépendances, fiabiliser les engagements et faciliter les arbitrages.

Vos missions

  • Installer et animer les rituels de synchronisation, les planifications et les revues d’incrément. Consolider les engagements et les jalons des équipes dans une feuille de route commune.

  • Identifier les dépendances, les risques et les blocages. Faciliter leur résolution avec les équipes, préparer les arbitrages et suivre les décisions jusqu’à leur mise en œuvre.

  • Registre des dépendances et risques critiques, avec responsables, échéances et plans de résolution.

  • Tableau de bord de prévisibilité couvrant les engagements, les jalons, les risques et les blocages.

  • Processus d’escalade et suivi des arbitrages.

  • Supports et comptes rendus de planification et de synchronisation, plans d’action et rapports d’avancement.

  • Plan d’amélioration continue et contributions au guide agile du programme.

Profil recherché

We ask that all of our ADRs have a remote environment that is conducive to consistent weekly motions and to be able to travel 4-6 times per year, usually a week or less at a time.

As an ADR I, you'll run long-term outbound and timely inbound prospecting motions to generate qualified pipeline for our sales team. Working emails, sales cadences, social outreach and most importantly calls to get in front of the right people at the right accounts at the right time. This role exists because a sustainable pipeline is built through persistence, consistency, a growth mindset and an ability to diagnose challenges and bring solutions within your own prospecting motion.

What you will do:

Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity.

The heart of a spacecraft lies in its propulsion system, and that's why we, at The Exploration Company, are dedicated to developing our own cutting-edge Propulsion Systems ensuring the highest level of efficiency and reliability in our space endeavours.

We want you as a talented Propulsion Functional Systems Engineer to contribute to the development, testing, analysis, prediction and refinement of the functional architecture for Nyx Earth Propulsion System Development Models.

In order to derisk and gain confidence on the flight propulsion system, different development models are being built in order to run a multitude of tests spanning from functional tests, cold flows to system level hot fires. This testing will allow for the verification and validation of all the propulsion subsystems. You will be responsible for bridging the gap between design and hardware testing for the Nyx spacecraft propulsion system. As such, you will work closely with both the design and testing teams to ensure seamless integration and validation of propulsion subsystems.

You will report to the Propulsion Development Models Principal Engineer.

Key responsibilities:

In your capacity as a Propulsion Functional Systems Engineer, you will be responsible for the development of analysis, post processing, and prediction tools that can support testing and design activities linked to the propulsion sub-systems.

Your role will be continuously evolving, but day-to-day responsibilities will include:

During the Design Phase:

  • Work closely with the pressure and feed system engineers to define the best configuration of the test setups, ensuring a high level of representativeness and testability to conduct all fluid modelling and analyses to verify repeatability of the test rigs with the flight systems and to perform test predictions.

  • Support on the creation of test plans for propulsion subsystems (from a modeling perspective), including data acquisition, analysis, and reporting to ensure the performance of the system can be assessed.

  • Design and develop propulsion analysis and post processing tools, to support testing activities and design maturation

  • Work in close collaboration with the pressure and feed system engineers to ensure the anchoring of the different fluidic models and assess against test data

During testing phase:

  • Provide on-site support during propulsion test campaigns, working closely with the test operator and test conductor.

  • Perform test campaigns, analysing in real-time, through different test parameters and ensure test results with timely resolution of any anomaly arising during testing.

  • Conduct pre-test and post-test reviews and elaborate the test reports.

  • Update and correlate the fluidic models based on test results.

  • Provide actionable insights to identify key performance indicators and potential critical scenarios

What we would love to see from you:

  • A minimum of a bachelor's degree in a related Engineering discipline.

  • +3 years of related experience in complex fluid systems, fluidic modeling, data analysis and data post processing.

  • Strong engineering fundamentals in thermodynamics, fluid dynamics, and combustion principles.

  • Familiarity with test facilities, or storable propulsion systems is an asset

  • Experience in propulsion systems storable or cryogenic fluidic systems is a plus.

  • Proficiency in python for fluid analyses, data post processing and model anchoring.

  • Experience in EcosimPro (or similar software) for the high fidelity analysis of numerical twins.

  • Proficiency in conducting fluid analyses using classical hand calculations

  • Excellent collaboration skills for working effectively across multidisciplinary teams.

  • Fluency in English.

Skills and Behaviours:

  • Strong oral and written communication skills.

  • Strong analysis and problem-solving skills.

  • Strong organizing and prioritization of tasks.

  • Strong team player with a proactive mindset.

  • Positive and flexible attitude to get the job done.

  • Ability to communicate at all levels of the business.

  • Demonstrates behaviours consistent with The Exploration Company’s core values of Mission, Vision, Integrity, Excellence and Teamwork.

  • Space enthusiast, ready to change the European space industry.

  • Nice to have, Ecosim experience

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly.

We are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable space orbital vehicle that can eventually be refueled in orbit, and which carries cargo - and potentially humans in the longer run.

We are seeking an experienced and talented Propulsion AIT Principal Engineer, to lead the Assembly, Integration and Test (AIT) activities for two cryogenic propulsion systems. Each system is supported by a dedicated AIT team.

This is a key leadership role that requires technical expertise in liquid-propellant propulsion systems, a strong track record in managing complex engineering projects, and proven experience in leading and mentoring technical teams.

As the Propulsion AIT Principal Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring safe, efficient and technically rigorous execution of propulsion AIT activities from hardware readiness through system-level testing and delivery, provide technical direction across both teams, coordinate priorities and resources, resolve complex technical issues, and ensure that the propulsion systems meet their performance, quality, schedule and safety objectives.

We are seeking an experienced and talented Propulsion Ground Support Equipment Team Leader, to lead the development, commissioning and operation of our engine test benches that we use to test our cryogenic engines and storable thrusters.

This is a key leadership role that requires technical expertise in liquid-propellant propulsion systems, a strong track record in managing complex engineering projects, and proven experience in leading and mentoring technical teams. The GSE Team Leader role for Liquid Propulsion Testing drives the end-to-end lifecycle – from initial concept and fluid/structural design to fabrication, commissioning, and operation – of critical ground infrastructure supporting liquid propellant rocket engine test campaigns.

As the GSE Team Leader, you will oversee the design, development and building of propulsion test facility. The primary objective is to develop and maintain robust, high-reliability test bench GSE that meets ambitious program cadences while ensuring absolute safety in hazardous operating environments.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the engineering development of new test facility GSE, including high-pressure gas distribution systems, propellant feed systems, electrical network, control and data acquisition system, mechanical structures, etc.

  • Translate test matrix requirements into hardware specifications, master P&IDs, and fluid system architectures

  • Direct resource allocation across multiple test benches, manage development schedules, and ensure alignment between propulsion design teams and facility operations

  • Oversee the structural fabrication, tube bending, welding, and mechanical assembly of GSE lines, panels, and thrust measurement structures

  • Manage data acquisition and control systems (DAQ/DCS) engineers and technicians to integrate sensors (pressure transducers, thermocouples, flow meters) and remote-actuated valves into the GSE infrastructure for automated test sequences and redline monitoring

  • Author structural and fluid safety calculations, hazard analyses, and standard operating procedures

Reporting to the Lead Anti-Corruption & Trade Compliance, the position offers genuine build-from-scratch ownership of core policies, processes and tools. It combines programme development, day-to-day compliance operations and cross-functional advisory work.

The role involves close collaboration with Legal, Finance, Procurement, Sales, Security, and Product and Engineering to translate legal requirements into clear, proportionate and auditable processes.

Anti-corruption/Sapin II

Economic sanctions and export controls

Required Expertise

8+ years in product management or product consulting for digital, AI or enterprise software in Life Sciences.

Hands-on expertise in batch record review and GMP manufacturing, or in CMC and regulatory submissions, with a solid understanding of GxP, data integrity and computerised system validation.

Track record of taking products from concept to market, working independently on defined mandates.

We build brands that work on shelf.

Not just on slides. Not just on Instagram.

Fast. Visible. Tangible. Scalable.

More than 90,000 retail locations worldwide.

We are looking for an Art Director (100%).

Not a traditional designer.

Someone with a deep understanding of FMCG design. Someone who knows what stops consumers at shelf, captures attention and drives sales.

Someone who takes ownership. From packaging and brand worlds to the smallest details that ultimately make the difference.

Someone who challenges existing ideas, wants to improve things and does not accept “the way it has always been done.”

This role is demanding, fast-paced and highly hands-on.

We are not looking for an administrator.

We are looking for a builder.

Someone who takes ownership, moves fast and executes with high quality.

Someone who wants to actively shape and grow brands. Not only conceptually, but all the way through to finished products in the market.

Aufgaben

You own everything that moves our brands visually and creatively forward with a clear focus on FMCG performance in the market.

  • Develop and execute creative concepts across all brands with a focus on visibility, recognition and impact
  • Build, sharpen and continuously evolve strong brand worlds with a consistent visual identity
  • Challenge existing approaches and actively improve things instead of simply maintaining them
  • Design packaging with clear FMCG logic: attention-grabbing, brand-right and built to convert at shelf
  • Develop web, social and marketing assets focused on performance, not aesthetics alone
  • Turn ideas into reality quickly, pragmatically and efficiently without getting stuck in endless feedback loops

Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role

You will be the first engineer on our Simulation team. Every site we map becomes a digital twin, built from our own lidar maps, and in it our robots see thousands of the intrusions, fires and sensor failures a real site sees once a year. Our multi-robot patrol policy was trained in simulation in under two hours on a single GPU and ran unmodified on real robots at three sites. Your job is to make that repeatable for every site and every new skill.

You will work with our Skills & Orchestration engineers, who train learned skills with reinforcement learning, and with our Reliability & Test Infrastructure engineer, who runs regression in the same simulator.

What You'll Work On

  • Map to twin: a pipeline from our lidar maps to simulation-ready digital twins: geometry, semantics, materials, sensors.

  • Training environments: RL environments for learned skills such as multi-robot patrol and search, randomised so nothing overfits one site.

  • Rare events: generate the scenarios real sites rarely produce: intrusions, sabotage, weather, sensor failures.

  • Sensor simulation: RGB, thermal and lidar realistic enough that what is learned in the twin holds on the robot.

  • Sim-to-real: measure the gap on real deployments and close it.

  • Scale: many parallel environments on GPUs, fast enough that a new skill trains in hours.

Who We're Looking For

A simulation engineer who treats the simulator as production infrastructure and measures success by what transfers to real robots.

Your Background

  • 3+ years building robotics simulation or RL training environments.

  • Hands-on with Isaac Sim or Isaac Lab; MuJoCo or Gazebo also considered.

  • Strong Python; C++ a plus.

  • 3D data: point clouds, meshes, scene formats such as USD.

  • GPU-parallel simulation and reinforcement learning workflows.

Nice to Have

  • Legged robots.

  • Photogrammetry, Gaussian splatting or other scene reconstruction.

  • ROS 2.

  • Thermal or lidar sensor modelling.

What We Offer

  • Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end.

  • Mission: autonomous security that keeps people and critical sites safe, including in defence.

  • Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow.

  • Compensation: Competitive equity/salary package

  • Culture: International founding team that is serious about building but does not take itself too seriously.

Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role

You will own the research question at the centre of LEA, our foundation model of the physical world: can a model learn what normally happens on a site, by place, hour and weather, so that an anomaly is simply what it did not expect? The first version is a probabilistic memory of each site. The next is a world model across every site that predicts the next state in latent space, starting from open world-model weights and growing on field data nobody else holds.

Our robots and cameras run on live security sites around the clock, and every event is kept with its clip, the model's verdict and the operator's outcome. That record is your dataset. You will work alongside our perception and model engineers, and your results go into production, not only into papers.

What You'll Work On

  • Site memory: a learned, probabilistic model of each site: which people, vehicles and robots are where, at what hour, in what weather, and how the scene usually unfolds.

  • Anomaly as surprise: replace rule-based alerting with measured surprise, and work out how to evaluate it when real incidents are rare.

  • World model: post-train open world-model weights on aligned multi-sensor field sequences, JEPA-style, predicting in latent space rather than pixels.

  • Transfer: from one site's memory to a model of all of them, and representations that carry across sites and domains.

  • Research direction: choose the questions, design the experiments, and decide what is true before it ships.

Who We're Looking For

A research scientist who has led work on world models, self-supervised learning or probabilistic spatio-temporal modelling, and who wants to see it run on real sites. You are rigorous about what a result does and does not show, and pragmatic about getting it into a product.

Your Background

  • PhD in machine learning, computer vision, robotics or a related field, with first-author publications at top venues.

  • Research experience in world models, video or latent prediction, self-supervised representation learning, or probabilistic modelling of spatio-temporal data.
