Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role

You will own the path a code change takes from commit to robot, and the evidence behind every gate on that path. Today the honest answer to "is this build safe?" is "it worked on the test robot." You will replace that with a system: the simulation environment the team tests against, the regression suites that run on every change, the hardware-in-the-loop rigs, and the release gates that decide whether a build can go onto a robot that will patrol a customer site alone tonight.

This is the first engineer dedicated to reliability and test infrastructure, and it sits in our Robot Autonomy team, next to the engineers building perception, localisation, planning and locomotion. Our robots patrol security sites, critical infrastructure and defence facilities without a human present, so a bad release is not a rollback: it is a customer incident. Within six months, nothing should reach a customer robot without passing something you built.

What You'll Work On

  • Release pipeline: code change, automated tests, simulation at scale, staging robot, pilot site, full rollout, with explicit pass criteria at every gate and nothing advancing without meeting them.

  • Simulation as infrastructure: a GPU-backed simulation environment (Isaac Sim today) running continuously, so engineers test against scenarios instead of queueing for the one robot in the lab.

  • Scenario libraries and regression suites: coverage across the whole on-robot stack, perception through locomotion, and the infrastructure to run thousands of scenarios on every change.

  • Hardware-in-the-loop: bench rigs and test procedures on the physical robots for what simulation cannot tell you.

  • Failure injection: drop sensors, degrade LiDAR returns, kill the network link, corrupt odometry, then verify the system degrades and recovers the way we tell customers it does.

  • Field incidents to tests: when a robot misbehaves on site, reproduce it deterministically and turn it into a permanent regression test.

  • Reproducibility: log capture, replay tooling, deterministic seeds, versioned scenarios, and coverage metrics that are honest about what they do not cover.

  • Acceptance criteria: turn product and customer requirements into measurable tests, and report against them without softening the numbers.

Who We're Looking For

A test, validation or reliability engineer who has shipped a product where failure had consequences, and who has seen what changes when a fleet goes from one unit to fifty. You treat simulation and CI as production infrastructure that you own, not tools you consume. You have judgment about what is worth testing: we want a safety net, not a wall of green ticks that hides the real risk. And you are comfortable being the person who says a build is not going out.

Your Background

  • 4+ years in test, validation, reliability, SRE or platform engineering on a product that shipped to customers.

  • Experience with a complex system at scale: autonomous driving, drones, industrial automation, medical devices or similar.

  • Strong Python and/or C++, with solid CI/CD and containerised infrastructure skills.

  • Hands-on with a robotics simulator run as production infrastructure: Isaac Sim preferred, Gazebo, MuJoCo or equivalent accepted.

  • Comfortable owning cloud infrastructure and GPU orchestration, not just consuming it.

  • Enough hardware literacy to read a timing problem or a flaky sensor trace, and the judgment to know when to hand it to Hardware.

Nice to Have

  • Fleet telemetry and observability (Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry).

Du hast noch nie im B2B-Vertrieb gearbeitet, möchtest aber gerne alle wichtigen Werkzeuge erlernen, um so richtig durchzustarten? Bei Salonkee lernst du den Vertrieb von Grund auf kennen und baust dir in Uri dein eigenes Netzwerk auf.

Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software – von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen.

Für einen Salon bedeutet das im Schnitt 70 % weniger Terminausfälle und 8 bis 12 Stunden weniger Verwaltungsaufwand pro Woche.

  • Deine Woche planst du eigenverantwortlich, mit klaren Zielen und einer Führungskraft, die dich unterstützt und weiterentwickelt.

Das bringst du mit

  • Vertriebserfahrung ist nicht unbedingt notwendig. Wenn du aus dem Hospitality, Beauty, Retail, Fitness, Event oder einem anderen Bereich mit viel Kundenkontakt kommst, bringst du das Wichtigste schon mit.

  • Du bist kontaktfreudig und gehst gerne in den Austausch – egal ob am Telefon oder direkt vor Ort.

  • Du bist in der Lage, Menschen zu begeistern und Interessen zu wecken.

  • Du kannst mit Ablehnung umgehen und richtest den Blick nach vorn.

  • Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln.

  • Du bist strukturiert, organisiert und sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

  • Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

  • Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

Das erwartet dich bei uns

  • Vertrieb von Grund auf lernen: Bootcamp zum Start, gezieltes Ramp-Up Programm, Shadowing bei erfahrenen Kolleg:innen, Roleplays und regelmäßiges Coaching.

  • Ein Team vor Ort: Team Lead und Kolleg:innen in deiner Region – du startest nicht allein.

  • Ein klarer Entwicklungspfad: von Junior über Senior bis hin zu Führungsrollen.

  • Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst.

  • Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

  • Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

  • Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision.

  • Teamevents, die ihren Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Teamformate.

Wie geht es weiter?

  1. Bewerbung & Sichtung – wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

  2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30–45 Minuten).

  3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

  4. Field Day – zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.

For a renowned Swiss bank in Zurich, we are looking for an experienced cloud and platform engineer. You will provision and run platform services as code, depending on the team, with a focus on Entra ID automation, a data platform on Azure or a Kafka platform on Kubernetes.

Your tasks

  1. Provision platform services with infrastructure as code, using Terraform, Helm and GitLab

  2. Automate build, test and release processes and run CI/CD pipelines

  3. Operate and develop Azure Kubernetes and storage accounts

  4. Depending on the team, automate Entra ID, build a data platform on Azure Postgres with lakehouse technologies, or upgrade Confluent Kafka on Kubernetes

Your profile

  1. German at C1 level or higher, the project language is German. Understanding of Swiss German is expected

  2. Very good Azure skills and experience with Kubernetes

  3. Infrastructure as code with Terraform

  4. DevOps toolchain with Git, GitLab, Docker and CI/CD

  5. Experience applying cloud security technologies

  6. Several years of experience at senior level

Nice to have

  1. Go, Python or Bash

  2. OAuth, SAML, OpenID Connect and Conditional Access

  3. Iceberg or Delta, Denodo

data.description:
Wir suchen einen erfahrenen Senior System Engineer, der die Gestaltung, den Betrieb und die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung moderner Datacenter-Umgebungen aktiv mitgestaltet. In dieser Position verbindest du fundiertes technisches Know-how mit operativer Verantwortung und treibst die Automatisierung, Optimierung von Services sowie die Weiterentwicklung zuverlässiger Infrastruktur-Lösungen voran.

Aufgaben & Verantwortlichkeiten

  • Du übernimmst die technische Verantwortung für definierte Infrastrukturplattformen, Services und Kundenumgebungen und fungierst als kompetente technische Ansprechperson.

  • Du stellst die Verfügbarkeit, Leistungsfähigkeit und Sicherheit der Datacenter-Systeme und Managed Services sicher und optimierst diese kontinuierlich.

  • Du identifizierst Potenziale zur Effizienzsteigerung durch Automatisierung, Standardisierung und die Weiterentwicklung bestehender Prozesse.

  • Du gestaltest die Weiterentwicklung von Infrastruktur-Services aktiv mit – von technischen Konzepten über Service-Vorlagen bis hin zu Self-Service-Lösungen.

  • Du koordinierst die Bearbeitung komplexer Incidents, Service Requests und Infrastrukturänderungen und bringst dich zudem im 2nd- und 3rd-Level-Support, in Kundenprojekten sowie beim Wissensaustausch ein.

Anforderungen & Qualifikationen

  • Du verfügst über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder ein Studium im Bereich Informatik, IT oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung. Eine weiterführende technische Ausbildung ist von Vorteil.

  • Du bringst mehrere Jahre praktische Erfahrung im Datacenter-Umfeld mit, insbesondere in den Bereichen Windows Server, Virtualisierung und komplexe Unternehmensinfrastrukturen.

  • Du besitzt fundierte Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Backup & Recovery, Netzwerktechnologien und Infrastruktur-Lösungen. Erfahrung mit Veeam oder Fortinet ist ein Plus.

  • Du hast Erfahrung im 2nd- und 3rd-Level-Support und verfügst über ein solides Verständnis von IT-Sicherheit, Datenschutz und Systemverfügbarkeit.

  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und lösungsorientiert, verfügst über ausgeprägte Problemlösungskompetenz und hast Freude an Automatisierung, kontinuierlicher Verbesserung und technischer Verantwortung.

Benefits & Unternehmenskultur

  • Ein kollegiales und unterstützendes Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Eigeninitiative, Wissensaustausch und gemeinsamer Erfolg gefördert werden.

  • Vielfältige Möglichkeiten zur fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung durch Weiterbildungen, technische Schulungen und neue Herausforderungen.

  • Flexible Arbeitsmodelle, eine positive Teamkultur und attraktive Zusatzleistungen, die eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance unterstützen.

data.title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer

data.description:
Join our mission

We're proud to work with many incredible companies, accelerating their ability to build their products.

We've spent years watching talented engineering teams lose momentum to the same frustrating bottleneck: waiting. Waiting for CI to finish. Waiting for builds to complete. Waiting for tests to run.

After experiencing this pain firsthand at companies of every size, we set out to build the developer infrastructure platform we'd always wanted to use. Something that would seamlessly integrate with our workflows and the tools teams already love—but make everything dramatically faster and more cost-effective.

Today, we're already accelerating hundreds of companies around the world, helping them ship features instead of waiting for infrastructure. We've built something that feels almost magical in its simplicity: change your runs-on line, mount your toolchain cache directory and suddenly your builds are 5x faster.

About the role

Namespace's approach is low-friction, designed for immediate integration into existing developer toolchains, empowering teams to experience tangible results within just five minutes. With an end-to-end stack optimized for high performance—including compute, memory, storage, and networking—Namespace delivers capabilities and efficiencies unmatched by traditional cloud providers.

Own the software that drives our hardware. You'll write the control planes, automation, and observability that keep our global fleet fast, efficient, and reliable, while charting a path to scale that continues to increase the number of "machines under management" per engineer.

Our culture

We're looking for people with grit—people who push through ambiguity, take ownership, and keep going when things get hard. You're deeply curious, driven to understand how things work and how they can be improved. Most importantly, you have a strong bias to execution: you don't wait for perfect conditions, you ship, learn, and iterate quickly. If you care about building, moving fast, and making real impact, you'll fit right in.

What you'll do

  • Manage and automate the fleet – build services for provisioning, health checks, upgrades, and incident remediation

  • Uphold reliability – embed observability, graceful degradation, and rollback paths into every layer you touch

  • Architect the network – design and evolve a high-throughput, low-latency fabric tailored to our high performance use-cases

  • Ship software, not scripts – develop clean, testable code (mostly Go) that treats our fleet like a first-class API

  • Drive efficiency – improve utilization and power-to-performance ratios so capacity grows slower than usage

  • Partner across the stack – work with product, infra, and platform teams to scope and deliver features like storage-aware scheduling, cache volumes, and other developer-facing features

What we're looking for

  • Proven experience engineering large-scale infrastructure - writing the software that runs fleets, not just operating existing hyperscalers

  • Depth in network architecture, data-center design, and performance tuning

  • Hands-on time deploying and managing compute hardware at scale (servers, switches, etc)

  • Fluency with modern orchestration and automation tooling (Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible - plus the judgment to know when to build vs. buy)

  • A track record of delivering reliable systems and measurable efficiency gains

You can expect:

  • Competitive salary and stock options

  • Flexible working hours

  • Market-leading parental leave

Life at Namespace Labs:

  • We pride ourselves in being a small team of experts that can achieve a lot.

  • We balance our long-term vision with short-term pragmatism.

  • We believe in being fully transparent internally on how decisions are made, on how the company is doing, and we use that information to drive our decisions.

Compensation: $150K – $225K • Offers Equity

data.description:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. 

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 
 
Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. 
 
The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.  

About the Job
 
The autonomy team at Gravis builds autonomous systems for excavators operating in real construction environments. You will build control modules that run on many different machines, across many sites, with different soil conditions. We’re looking for a roboticist with data driven planning and/or control background, deep python expertise and good level of C++ proficiency.
 
To be successful in this role you should have experience working with real robots, tackling the challenges of sim2real transfer, and deploying robotic systems in a production environment.
 
 

What you will do
Learning-Based Planning and Control for Real Systems
 
  • Develop data driven planning and control systems for autonomous excavation that generalize across machine models and soil conditions
  • Contribute to  simulation improvements that reduce or address the sim2real gap
  • Define data collection and curation pipelines for incorporating real data in policy training 
  • Design experiments focused on continuous performance and robustness improvements.
  • Explore the usage of adaptive and online reinforcement learning in deployed systems
  • Provide mentorship and supervision for junior team members, interns, and students.
    •  
    System Integration
     
  • Integrate learned components into a larger software stack
  • Collaborate with excavation and motion planning engineers
  • Build tools for analysing and evaluating the behavior of learned components

    • What we’re looking for

    We recognize that excellent candidates come from diverse backgrounds with various combinations of skills. If you meet most of the core qualifications below, we highly encourage you to apply.

    Core qualifications

  • 2–5 years industry experience developing Reinforcement learning systems for control and/or planning and deploying them on real robots with a customer. If you only have experience with simulation, you’re most likely not a good fit for this position.

  • Experience with GPU accelerated simulation environments (e.g. IsaacSim/IsaacLab, CARLA, MuJoCo)

  • Strong Python skills and experience with PyTorch or similar libraries

  • Proficiency in C++

  • Comfortable debugging real-world system behavior

  • Ability and willingness to travel as required by business projects. 

    • Great-to-Have Skills & Experience

  • Experience with hydraulic machinery

  • Experience with supervised learning or imitation learning

  • Research experience in reinforcement learning

  • Experience deploying robotic systems at scale (e.g. hundreds of units)

  • Familiarity with ROS or similar robotics frameworks

  • Experience with feature-flagged deployments, staged rollouts, or long-lived platforms

  • Experience with data curation for ML applications

  • Experience guiding, mentoring, or leading junior colleagues, students, or project teams. 

  • Familiarity with or interest in utilizing AI coding tools. 

    • This Role is a Great Fit If

  • You are passionate about building systems that work reliably in the real world

  • You want to help build a long-lived excavation planning and control system intended to scale and positively impact the entire construction industry. 

  • You are comfortable working with the realities of imperfect data and noisy measurements.

  • You have a keen interest in bridging the sim2real gap and understanding the differences between simulation and physical environments. 

  • You are excited to help drive technical direction in a growing team transitioning from prototyping to the product stage.

  • You value a collaborative team culture rooted in thoughtful design, creative thinking, mutual respect, and pragmatism. 

    • Don't meet every requirement? If you're enthusiastic about this role but your experience doesn't match every qualification, we still encourage you to apply. You might be the perfect candidate for this or other positions. This is an opportunity to join a dynamic and versatile team, and to be part of a young startup that will revolutionize heavy construction.
     
    Gravis Robotics offers a fair market salary and a working location in the vibrant city of Zurich. As a forward-facing startup, we understand that work-life balance and flexibility are important considerations for many professionals:
     
    If you are a highly qualified candidate with the requisite skills and experience, we encourage you to apply and discuss your preferred working arrangement during the interview process. Gravis is an equal opportunity employer.
     
    We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team, and do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity, gender expression, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics. We are an international team that is working to solve problems with a global impact: to facilitate efficient communication and collaboration, proficiency in English is a requirement for all roles.

🍇 About grape: 
 
Our entrepreneurial spirit drives us in what we do and what we are passionate about. Our mission is to become the premier health partner in the insurance business. Recognising the need for innovation in the traditional employee insurance model we are set to revolutionize the employee insurance industry. We help companies support people before and after they get sick and to make more of their time. Our insurance solutions reduce monotonous and manual work for employees, doctors, HR & payroll managers. As we strive to lead a technology-driven transformation, we put employees first.
 
At grape we pride ourselves on our people and our culture. We continue to grow fast and that’s where you come in. Our team is dynamic, diverse and full of creative ideas. Want to join? We can’t wait to get to know you!

Your role

As Head of Distribution, you own grape’s commercial engine end to end: Broker Sales, Direct Sales, Brand & Marketing, Customer Success and Revenue Operations. You carry the new nARR and renewal targets and lead the team leads who deliver them. 
You take this function over from our co-founder, grow it further, and represent Distribution on grape’s Leadership Team.


What you'll do:

  1. Own the numbers: Deliver new nARR and renewal targets across broker, direct and partner channels. Own forecast accuracy, pipeline health and the channel mix.

  2. Lead the commercial organisation: Lead five team leads, set OKRs, hold the performance bar, develop the next layer of leaders and hire ahead of growth.

  3. Win the broker channel: Own decision-maker relationships with key broker houses and steer the tender season on quality, speed and win rate.

  4. Build the end-to-end funnel: Set clear stage ownership and KPIs from first touch to renewal. Align closely with underwriting on deal flow and pricing, and steer RevOps on tooling, data quality and forecasting.

  5. Retain and grow the book: Own the renewal rate and retention playbook, drive platform and grape connect adoption, and turn customer and broker insight into product input.

  6. Work across the company: Represent Distribution on the Leadership Team and in board reporting. Partner with Product, Insurance Supply and Operations.


What you'll need:
  • 10+ years in commercial roles, including 5+ years leading a multi-team organisation through team leads.
  • A track record of delivering multi-million B2B revenue targets repeatedly.
  • Experience in a B2B market sold through intermediaries; Swiss insurance, employee benefits or pensions is a strong plus.
  • Experience scaling a commercial organisation, ideally in a venture-backed company.
  • Strong pipeline, forecasting and funnel analytics; uses CRM (ideally HubSpot) as a steering tool.
  • Understanding of, or a fast route to learning, insurance commercial mechanics: premium, loss ratio and renewal pricing.
  • VBV registration, or readiness to obtain it promptly.
  • Fluent German and English; French and Swiss German are a plus.
  • Credible with brokers, your team and the Board; direct, data-driven and comfortable disagreeing upward.

    • What makes you stand out:
  • Existing relationships in the Swiss broker market.
  • You’re both builder and operator: you write the growth model and sit in the tender review.
  • The leaders who reported to you grew, and they stayed.
    • 🤝 What we offer in return:
    🌱 Empowering workplace: Join a passionate team and an empowering workplace where you are given the ownership, tools, and support to make decisions and take initiative. Together we grow and build innovative solutions.
    💻  Hybrid setup: Enjoy the flexibility of our hybrid work schedule, with the freedom to work remotely or from our office in Zurich. On Thursdays, our team day, we meet together in our Zurich office.
    🪑 Home office stipend: To enable our hybrid setup, we allocate a one-off CHF 200.- home office budget to help you set up your dream workspace in the comfort of your own home.
    🌐 Internet allowance: We give you a monthly internet allowance to help cover your internet costs at home and enable you to work seamlessly from your home office.
    ⏳ Flexible working time: You can distribute your working hours the way you want to.
    🧠 Learning budget: We support you in improving your skills, acquiring new knowledge and advancing your career. We also allocate a CHF 1'500.- budget annually
    ❤️‍🩹  Well-being: Work-life balance is important to us and we foster a supportive work environment. We support you with mental health sessions with our partner Aepsy.
    🎫  Team events: Every month we gather for fun and engaging events where we can connect and bond with our colleagues and our teams.
    ✈️  Team retreats: Once a year we travel somewhere nice to bond with our colleagues.
    🚂  Travel and commute: We will cover your SBB half fare card, so we can spend some time together in the office.
    🌴 Paid vacation: You get 5 weeks (25 days) of paid vacation every year and 2 additional days of paid vacation to compensate for canton-related holidays, religious holidays, birthdays, etc. The total amount of paid vacation days per year is 27 days.
    🧖‍♀️ Wellness budget: Health and well-being looks different for everyone. You can optimize your wellness budget to best fit your needs.
    👨‍👨‍👦‍👦 Parental and adoptive leave: We offer additional time off to support employees who are balancing family and work time in the most crucial stages of family life.
    ✈️ Digital nomad: For every 3 years of employment, you can work for an extended period of time from anywhere in the world (location subject to review).
     
    🏁 Our recruitment process
    We place particular emphasis on four areas when making our selection decision: professional and technical skills, mindset & values. We evaluate these through the following steps:
     
    Step 1 - Your motivation
    To get to know you better, we invite you to a 30-minute motivational interview with our Talent Acquisition Team.
    Step 2 - Role fit
    In the first interview, we assess how well your qualifications and skills align with the role requirements. This discussion will take place with your Hiring Manager.

    Throughout the interview process, you'll gain insight into our company culture, and we'll explore how your values and mindset align with our ways of working. The final interview will offer a deeper look into this connection, along with broader discussions about the role and our vision.

We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Leader, EMEA Product Support role manages Benchling support in EMEA. As the team leader (a player-coach role), you’ll manage Product Support Analalyts in Europe and spend roughly 40% of your time directly owning customer issues and our most complex escalations. This role owns live customer-impacting incidents for enterprise pharma and biotech customers, helps shape an AI-first support model, and sits close to CX leadership. Working closely with our Global Support and CX Leadership Teams, you’ll combine team leadership, incident management, and thoughtful AI adoption to help scale a modern, efficient Support organization. 

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead and coach your team: run daily regional support operations including prioritization and resourcing, hold regular team meetings and career growth conversations, and build a culture where people feel supported and excited to grow.

  • Partner with the Incident Center of Excellence to mature the incident process (post-incident reviews, closing action items, communication playbooks, severity-based response criteria), and help build and run a sustainable off-hours coverage model, including personally rotating in as an escalation responder.

  • Analyze support metrics (volume, severity trends, time-to-resolution, comms timeliness) to inform staffing and process decisions, and report trends to CX leadership.

  • Drive consistent adoption of AI tools across support workflows, piloting ways to reduce ticket-handling time, surface account context automatically, and free up analyst time for higher-value work.

  • Collaborate with Build, Product, Technical Account Managers, Customer Success, and Professional Services on customer issues and incidents, keep help content and product knowledge current, and represent support at customer-facing events as needed.

  • Work the queue alongside your team: own complex, high-priority, and escalated tickets, serve as a first-line contact for regional escalations, and model the troubleshooting, investigation, and communication standards you expect from others.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experienced leader who coaches with empathy and stays close to the work, with 1+ years of management experience and 5+ years of SaaS support or professional services, or demonstrated leadership, including assigning ticket work and managing queues and resources. Able to personally troubleshoot and resolve complex customer issues.

  • Working knowledge of support and incident tooling and best practices for technical support environments (e.g. Salesforce, Zendesk, JIRA, PagerDuty, or equivalent), plus genuine enthusiasm for AI in support, ideally with hands-on experience piloting or driving adoption.

  • Sound judgment under pressure: prioritizing by urgency, severity, and customer health context, and skilled in customer-facing crisis communication, including what to say, when, and to whom during a live incident, and how to translate root cause into clear RCAs/ISNs.

  • Experience with enterprise-grade support: managing high-stakes accounts holistically, building trust with sophisticated customers, and thinking beyond individual ticket resolution.

  • Strong communicator and customer advocate with a bias toward action, comfortable working independently across departments, remote teams, and external stakeholders. Bachelor’s degree in a life sciences related field recommended (biology, microbiology, genetics, biotechnology, neurology, etc.); research or lab experience is a big plus.

  • Based in the Zurich area, or willing to relocate, and able to work on-site in our Zurich office Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday.

     

HOW WE WORK

We offer a flexible hybrid work arrangement that prioritizes in-office collaboration. Employees are expected to be on-site 3 days per week (Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday).

Die Organisation:

Kannst du dir vorstellen internatione/r Rekrutierer/in zu sein? Dann hast du das richtige Stellenangebot für dich gefunden! Zur Erweiterung unseres Teams, suchen wir eine/n begeisterte/n Kollegen/in.

PhysioMatch vermittelt abenteuerlustige Physiotherapeuten und Physiotherapeutinnen aus ganz Europa, vor allem an Praxen in der Schweiz. PhysioMatch tut dies in Zusammenarbeit mit CareToMatch, das seinen Sitz in der Schweiz hat. Bewerber und Kunden stellen uns ihre Anforderungen zur Verfügung und wir kümmern uns um den Abgleich. Du begleitest den Physiotherapeuten dann persönlich durch den Auswanderungsprozess.

Aufgaben

Als Personalvermittler/in bei PhysioMatch konzentrieren sich du und deine Kollegen/innen auf die Schweiz. Du vermittelst arbeitssuchenden Physiotherapeuten an die Stelle, die am besten zu ihr/ihm passt. Natürlich müssen einige Dinge arrangiert werden, um in der Schweiz arbeiten zu können, wobei du den Kandidaten bei diesem Abenteuer mit maßgeschneiderten Informationen hilfst. Physiotherapeuten sind oft sehr kontaktfreudig, sodass du nette persönliche Gespräche führen kannst.

Du kannst auch aus verschiedenen abwechslungsreichen Aktivitäten wählen, wie zum Beispiel:

  • Rekrutierung geeigneter Kandidaten;

  • Informiere und vermittle die Kandidaten auf persönliche Art und Weise;

  • Mitdenken und mithelfen bei kreativen Marketingkampagnen;

  • Pflege und Ausbau von Kontakten;

  • Du erstellst attraktive Stellenangebote, veröffentlichst sie auf der Website und bewirbst sie in den sozialen Medien;

  • Erkennen und Erfassen der Bedürfnisse und Möglichkeiten von Bewerbern und Kunden.

Qualifikation

  • Gute mündliche und schriftliche Beherrschung der (niederländischen und) deutschen Sprache;

  • Französischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil, aber nicht unbedingt erforderlich;

data.description:
About Vitestro

Founded in 2017 in Utrecht, Vitestro is pioneering the future of blood collection with the Aletta® Autonomous Robotic Phlebotomy Device™ (ARPD™). This groundbreaking medical device combines advanced multi-modal imaging (near-infrared, ultrasound, and Doppler ultrasound) with robotics and AI to perform the entire diagnostic blood draw procedure autonomously.

 

By addressing critical healthcare staffing shortages and improving patient experience, Vitestro is transforming one of the most common and essential medical procedures. With more than 130 team members and growing rapidly, we are scaling our impact. As we placed our first devices with customers, we are now expanding our team to ensure successful implementation and long-term reliability.

 

At Vitestro, we are committed to continuous innovation and improvement.

Master Data Engineer

As our Master Data Engineer, you own the accuracy and integrity of the master data behind every Aletta we build: items, bills of materials (BOMs), revisions and routings in our ERP system. You translate the engineering BOM released by R&D into the manufacturing BOM for products, sub-assemblies and spare parts. You also own the change control process between Engineering, Operations and Supply Chain, from the first change request to the verified change in the build. This is a newly created role in our Operations team.

First months at Vitestro

In your first months, your focus will be on two things. First, you set up the change process end to end: from an engineering change to its implementation in the build, including the impact on time and cost. You register changes, organize the impact assessment with Operations, Supply Chain and Quality, chair the change review board, and define effectivity and the disposition of existing stock. Second, you build the manufacturing BOMs for our products from the engineering BOMs. You structure sub-assemblies to match the assembly sequence, add consumables, packaging, labels, kitting and the make/buy split, and set up spare-part and service BOMs together with Service. Along the way, you define how system and module upgrades are managed through the BOM.

You become the single point of contact for master data and change implementation. You make sure every build uses the correct released configuration, so that each Device History Record traces back to the Device Master Record.

This is what success looks like:

After 12 months, engineering changes run through one controlled process, and every change is implemented, verified in the first build and closed in the change record. Product and spare-part BOMs are free of errors, and master data is audit-ready under ISO 13485. Engineering, Operations and Supply Chain know where a change stands and when it reaches the build. Regular comparisons between E-BOM, M-BOM and as-built show no open discrepancies.

You thrive at the intersection of engineering and operations. You are precise and process-minded, you keep the discipline when others are in a hurry, and you are comfortable holding a change that isn't ready yet.


What You’ll Bring:

  • A bachelor's or master's background in Mechanical, Mechatronics or Industrial Engineering, or a similar technical field

  • 3+ years in master data, BOM, configuration or engineering change management in a manufacturing environment, preferably MedTech or high-tech

  • Experience with an ERP system, such as Odoo, SAP or Exact

  • Solid understanding of E-BOM and M-BOM structures, item lifecycle and revision control

  • Strong ability to align cross-functional stakeholders and keep process discipline

  • Comfortable working with detail: analytical, accurate and process-minded

  • Excellent communication skills

  • Fluent in English

Nice to have:

  • Experience in a regulated environment (ISO 13485, DMR/DHR, design transfer)

  • Familiarity with a PLM system

  • Experience reading technical drawings, and basic 3D CAD knowledge

  • Experience with advanced Excel or data tooling for data validation

  • Dutch language skills

How We Work

At Vitestro, ownership is not a slogan - it is an expectation. We trust people to take responsibility, make decisions, and drive work forward.

We believe breakthroughs happen when talented people combine dedication, accountability, and teamwork. That means:

  • We take initiative rather than wait for direction.

  • We focus on execution and delivering results.

  • We proactively remove blockers and help each other succeed.

  • We challenge ideas, not people.

  • We continuously learn, improve, and raise the bar.

  • We celebrate team success over individual heroics.

We move fast, but we do so thoughtfully. We care deeply about quality because the technology we build ultimately impacts patients and healthcare professionals.

If you are looking for an environment where you can make a significant contribution, take ownership of meaningful work, and be surrounded by highly motivated colleagues, we'd love to meet you.

What we offer 

  • Competitive salary including pension plan 

  • 25 days of annual leave based on a full-time position 

  • Hybrid work model 

  • Working together in a high-skilled team with our home base in Utrecht 

  • Frequent out-of-work activities with our team, and annual company weekend away.

  • Training budget 

  • Opportunity to be key shaper of a new global industry niche: autonomous medical robotics 

We’re big fans of working from the office – this is where team spirit comes alive. At the same time, we offer flexibility, allowing up to two (out of 5) days of working from home for those who prefer it. 

Are you excited? 

We totally understand that and so are we! By joining us, you can play an active role in changing the future of health care. Excited to join our revolution? Then we’d love to hear from you! 

If you think you've got what it takes, but you don't meet all the requirements - we still recommend you apply. We would love to learn about your interest and experience and consider if you can be a good fit for Vitestro. Nobody is a perfect fit, and we welcome applications with imperfections. We offer a learning environment where we grow together!

Ontwerp en programmeer jij graag de nieuwste deegverwerkingsmachines van AMF Bakery Systems? Step dan in als Senior Controls Engineer! Hecht je aan betrokken en slimme collega's waarmee je samen 'state of the art' voedselproductielijnen ontwerpt, programmeert en bouwt? Super, dan zijn we op zoek naar jou!

We werken met ruim 220 collega’s in Nederland – vanuit Gorinchem, Amersfoort en Nieuwleusen – en maken deel uit van de internationale Markel Food Group. Samen bouwen we aan iets groters dan alleen machines. We bouwen aan een toekomst waarin we samen kunnen groeien, leren en impact maken.

Jouw Missie bij CCS

Geen dag is hetzelfde in deze rol. Samen met je collega’s zorg je ervoor dat wij succesvol onze softwareoplossingen bij klanten implementeren en dat onze klanten een excellente dienstverlening krijgen! Voor deze complexe systeemimplementaties en integratieprojecten zoeken we een zeer ervaren projectmanager. Je leert de verzekeringsbranche kennen en klanten helpen. Dat doe je niet alleen: je werkt samen met enthousiaste collega’s in een projectteam.

Voordelen voor de sollicitant

Als projectmanager krijg je veel verantwoordelijkheid, help je klanten en samen met je projectteam zet je mooie resultaten neer. Je kunt deels thuiswerken, deels op ons kantoor in Woerden en bij verschillende klanten in Nederland. Tijdelijk werken vanuit het buitenland kan ook dankzij onze workation-regeling (maximaal 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar).

Bij ons draait het om klantgericht werken én werkplezier. Daarom is er volop ruimte voor ontspanning en plezier. Denk aan een levend tafelvoetbaltoernooi, pubquiz en een bier- & wijnproeverij. Ons actieve Fun-team zorgt elke maand weer voor iets leuks.

En als je reislust nog niet is gestild met 25 vakantiedagen en een workation, dan kun je zelfs tot 20 extra verlofdagen bijkopen. Genoeg redenen om verder te lezen en te ontdekken of deze functie iets voor jou is, toch?


Een voorbeeld van je werkdag

Opstarten: Aan het begin van je werkdag heb je een dagstart met zowel collega’s als projectteamleden van de klant. Hierin bespreken jullie de voortgang, resultaten en eventuele hulpvragen.

Na de dagstart: Allereerst neem je nog wat tijd met een van de consultants naar aanleiding van de dagstart. Je coacht en begeleidt de consultant en helpt deze met een hulpvraag. Vervolgens ga je aan de slag met het opstellen van de voortgangsrapportage. Hiermee zorg je voor proactieve en transparante rapportage over het project aan de klant. De stuurgroep met de klant is volgende week, vandaag spreek je samen met de delivery manager deze stuurgroep voor. Wat zijn de belangrijkste punten voor de klant en voor CCS en hoe vliegen we die aan.

Na de lunch: Je checkt nog een paar tickets qua voortgang op het planboard, waarbij je de samenhang met de planning checkt. Vervolgens ga je naar de werksessie met het CCS projectmanagement guild. Hier werken jullie aan tickets om de CCS Prince2Agile projectmethodiek verder te verbeteren. Hierna heb je nog een afspraak met je collega van sales voor afstemming over een mogelijk vervolgproject bij de klant.

Wie jij bent

De ideale kandidaat beschikt over daadkracht, doorzettingsvermogen, enthousiasme en drive om projecten succesvol te leiden en verbeteringen door te voeren om te komen tot nog efficiëntere en klantgerichte projecten. Jij herkent jezelf in de volgende punten:

· Je wordt blij van projectmanagement en blijft kalm bij verschuivende prioriteiten;

· Je hebt bewezen ervaring met het succesvol uitvoeren van productsoftware-implementaties in een complexe, maar klantgerichte omgeving, binnen budget, planning en scope;

· Je hebt ruime ervaring met diverse projectmanagement en delivery methodieken, bij voorkeur een Prince2-, Ipma of PMI of Agile / scrum certificaat;

· Je vindt, net als wij, klanttevredenheid het uitgangspunt. Daarbij ben je in staat om de klantverwachtingen helder te analyseren, te managen en actief bij te sturen waar nodig;

· Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal uitstekend in woord en geschrift;

· Jouw persoonlijkheid kenmerkt zich door: gestructureerd, motiverend, communicatief sterk, duidelijk, open, tikje eigenwijs, enthousiast, relativerend, creatief en pragmatisch;

· Je haalt energie uit het opstellen en bewaken van planningen, analyseren van gegevens en opstellen van duidelijke, gestructureerde rapportages en presentaties;

· Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde bachelor, bij voorkeur richting bedrijfskunde, bedrijfseconomie en/of informatica.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Naast de genoemde leuke functie binnen een groeiend en innovatief bedrijf bieden wij:

· Salaris: We bieden je een salaris tussen € 5.590 en € 7.958 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur per week), afhankelijk van je ervaring en kennis;

· Middelen: Leaseauto, laptop, telefoon;

Ben jij een student die energie krijgt van processen doorgronden en puzzels oplossen, met interesse in privacy en data? Wil je bijdragen aan een duurzamere wereld en zien hoe nieuwe wetgeving landt in een snel groeiend bedrijf? Dan is MyWheels op zoek naar jou!

Over MyWheels

MyWheels gelooft in een toekomst waarin je mobiliteit inricht op wat je écht nodig hebt, niet op wat je bezit. Toegang tot de juiste auto, op het juiste moment. Wij bouwen het platform dat dat mogelijk maakt.

Als grootste elektrische mobiliteitsplatform van Nederland gaan we verder dan toegang tot een auto. Via Vehicle-to-Grid (V2G) leveren onze elektrische auto’s ook stroom terug aan het energienet. Zo pakken we tegelijk de netcongestie aan en bouwen we aan de energie- én mobiliteitsvoorziening van de toekomst. ⚡

Vanuit ons kantoor in Amsterdam werkt een enthousiast team van zo’n 50 mensen aan dit platform. Samen bouwen we aan iets wat echt telt.

Wat ga je doen?

Als stagiair Privacy & Data ondersteun je ons bij het verder brengen van ons privacy-programma in de breedste zin van het woord. Je werkt mee aan onze processen en verwerkingen, en verdiept je in de Leidraad Data Delen van de ACM, die praktische richtlijnen geeft over hoe de Europese Data Act door Nederlandse bedrijven moet worden uitgevoerd. Je werkt nauw samen met onze Security Lead, die je begeleidt, en kunt steunen op zijn contacten met onze Functionaris Gegevensbescherming en de Legal Counsel van onze moedermaatschappij.

Je werkt nauw samen met onze Security Lead, jouw begeleider.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

  • Je houdt ons register van verwerkingen actueel en brengt onze processen en verwerkingen visueel in kaart, in gesprek met collega’s uit alle teams;

  • Je duikt in klantklachten over privacy en ontrafelt de lastige gevallen: wat is er gebeurd, en hoe lossen we het op?;

  • Signaleren van quick wins en verbeterkansen op het gebied van privacy en data.


  • Verbondenheid met de duurzame impact doelstellingen van MyWheels;

We are looking for a Sentinel System Engineer on behalf of the European Space Agency (ESA) for their location in Noordwijk, the Netherlands. 

 

Please note, the successful candidate will be employed by ATG Europe (or one of its subsidiaries). Furthermore, upon selection, they will be subject to a general security screening performed by an external provider (further information will be provided at the interview stage). 

 

ATG is dedicated to diversity and inclusion and is an equal opportunity employer. Regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, or any other reason protected by relevant state or municipal legislation, we are pleased to consider all eligible candidates for employment. 

 

The successful candidate will be tasked with, but not limited to: 

 

  • Coordinate the internal & external support to PLS (ESA Space Segment Development Team, TEC experts, Mission Analysis & System Support, Industry);  

  • Coordinate with the ESA Space Segment Development Team (where relevant) to exchange technical status on the flying- and non-flying satellite(s), identifying coordination issues of relevance and following them to conclusion;  

  • Support PLS at the regular (weekly) Operations Boards; 

  • Support the Operations Team(s) by providing or facilitating responses to technical support requests from either the Flight Operations Segment (FOS) or Payload Data Ground Segment (PDGS);  

  • Maintain & distribute the PLS On-Call lists to the FOS (& other parties where relevant) in a timely manner; 

  • Support the Mission Manager and his/her team by providing technical advice related to issues of Satellite(s) performance; 

  • Support the Space Segment Development Team(s) by providing timely & pertinent feedback on any issue detected in-flight with potential impact on satellite(s) still under development;  

  • Provide specific technical expertise to support Performance Monitoring, Analysis & Optimisation tasks and Anomaly Investigations, with overall aim to improve mission quality and/or lifetime; 

  • Preparation of Technical Documentation, such as Reports, Technical Notes and other requested documentation; 

  • Review and synthesis of Technical Reports and documents produced by Industry, and extraction of relevant technical information for use in generation of PLS Performance metrics and reports; 

  • Organise and support the 6-monthly Satellite In-Orbit Performance (SIOP) Technical Meetings in cooperation with the Industrial Prime contractor, including associated follow-up activities (eg. administration, actions follow up etc); 

  • Respond to Anomaly Warnings received from the Flight Operations Segment (FOS) in an appropriate & timely manner, providing support and facilitating the necessary follow-on actions;  

  • Support and lead complex investigations that arise as a result of satellite performance and anomalies, ensuring adequate coordination with involved partners (Mission Management, Operations Team(s), Industry, Space Segment Development Team(s), Management);   

  • Prepare, coordinate & follow-up on engineering requests for the Industrial contractors in support of Anomaly Investigations and other technical analyses;   

  • Support satellite configuration control including the Configuration Control Board (CCB);   

  • Support Satellite Decommissioning & Disposal activities as required;   

  • Monitor, track and report the status of activities performed by the Industrial contractors in support of the PLS function (technical, commercial and schedule status);  

  • Review commercial payment requests & the associated justifications submitted by Industry (regular milestones or as result of ad-hoc Cost Reimbursement activities);   

  • Bring innovation to satellite performance analysis by investigating emerging technologies that enhance the ability for early detection of performance trends and deviations;   

  • Maintain the relevant PLS technical records, databases & documentation in accordance with established procedures;   

  • Maintain a regular reporting in coordination with the Technical Officer. 


Please ensure that your CV clearly explains how you meet the mandatory requirements. If it doesn’t align completely with the essential criteria, it could result in rejection. 

Requirements  

  • University degree in a relevant Engineering discipline;   

  • Minimum 10 years of experience and a significant background in one or more of the following domains: Satellite Operations, Spacecraft Development (including Project Engineering, Equipment/Subsystem Procurement, Assembly Integration & Test);   

  • Minimum 3 years’ experience working as a System Engineer or with a System Coordination function in any of the above domains;   

  • Good understanding of the Satellite Phase E2 Routine Operations Organisation and the typical activities performed;

Several of Europe's largest retailers, from Albert Heijn to Edeka, have joined Simvia together with their suppliers, and our network now spans more than 200,000 suppliers in 130 countries. Our culture is driven and kind, and it only works if you bring both. 

Driven by the mission. You set ambitious goals, own the outcome, and welcome a high bar. 

Frank. You say what you think and would rather hear the truth than a comfortable story. 

Open. You ask for feedback and change your mind when the facts change. 

Trusting. You build real relationships and give others room to own their work.

An intro call with our People & Culture team, a conversation with the hiring manager, an assignment, a culture conversation and an offer. Every process includes an assignment, because we would rather see your work than hear about it. We move fast and keep you informed at every step.

BlockTech is hiring a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join its Tech department in Amsterdam.

Crypto markets never close, and neither does our trading. Bare-metal hosts, cloud instances, exchange connectivity, messaging, and the trading services on top all have to work around the clock.

In this role, you'll sit between infrastructure, engineering, and trading, and follow every problem wherever it leads.

About BlockTech

BlockTech is an algorithmic trading firm headquartered in Amsterdam, with a second office in Singapore. We specialize in market making and trade cryptocurrency derivatives and spot markets globally, using our own capital. We're growing fast and expanding into new markets.

We trade options and delta one around the clock on the largest crypto venues. Our platform runs on a Linux bare-metal fleet alongside cloud deployments in the regions where exchanges run, with services written in Python and Rust.

What will you do?

You will make sure everything works, and works properly. Most problems don't stay inside one team's boundaries: a strange fill might come from a network issue, a config change, or an exchange that changed its behavior without telling anyone. You understand what each service does for trading, what it costs when it breaks, and which fix matters most right now. You own an issue from the first alert to the long-term fix that stops it coming back.

You will:

  • Own the live environment. Monitor trading across all our venues, take charge of incidents, and own both the immediate fix and the long-term one.

  • Bridge infrastructure, engineering, and trading. Translate a trader's “something looks off” into a root cause, and a root cause into a priority the right team can act on.

  • Partner with the desk. Work closely with traders and quants, so reliability work is driven by what actually matters for PnL and risk.

  • Debug across the full stack. Linux and network performance, exchange connectivity, messaging and databases (Kafka, NATS, Redis, PostgreSQL/TimescaleDB, ClickHouse), and the Python and Rust trading services themselves.

  • Own our hybrid infrastructure. Run the bare-metal fleet and cloud deployments, plus their configuration management and deployment pipelines across environments.

  • Build observability. Use Prometheus/VictoriaMetrics, Grafana, Sentry, and Kibana to catch a problem before the trading desk does.

  • Change things safely. Plan and run maintenance, upgrades, and releases without trading going dark.

  • Raise the bar. Cut toil with automation, and spread SRE practices across Tech so every team builds reliable systems from the start.

What we're looking for

You'll need:

  • 5+ years running production systems where uptime and correctness matter, in an SRE, DevOps, systems, or software engineering role.

  • At least 2 years of that in a trading environment (a trading firm, exchange, or broker), working directly with live trading systems and traders.

  • A working understanding of how trading systems operate: order and quote flow, positions and PnL, exchange connectivity, and why latency and correctness matter.

  • A commercial mindset. You can weigh technical trade-offs against business impact and explain them clearly to traders and engineers alike.

  • Strong Linux skills, including troubleshooting performance at the OS and kernel level.

  • Solid networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, UDP, and multicast, plus comfort reading a packet capture.

  • Hands-on experience running production workloads in a public cloud (AWS or similar): networking (VPCs, peering, cross-region latency), compute choices, and infrastructure as code (Terraform or similar).

  • Proficiency in Python, and the ability to read and debug code you didn't write, including our Rust services.

  • Hands-on experience with configuration management (Ansible or similar) and CI/CD.

  • Experience operating at least some of our stack: Kafka, NATS, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redis, Prometheus, or Grafana.

  • Calm, structured incident handling, and clear communication in English under pressure.

Bonus points for:

  • Experience with options or crypto markets.

  • Exchange connectivity experience (WebSocket or FIX APIs).

  • Low-latency or market-making environments.

  • Hands-on Rust experience. Much of our platform is written in it.

  • Network hardware (Arista, Cisco), routing protocols, or packet capture tooling.

  • Server hardware and kernel tuning for low latency.

  • Running data-heavy systems such as time-series databases.

Pay, location, and relocation

  • Compensation: a competitive base salary plus a performance bonus based on individual and company results.

  • Trading fund: outstanding performance is rewarded with the opportunity to buy into the trading fund.

  • Location: On-site at our Amsterdam office

  • Visa: BlockTech sponsors the Dutch highly skilled migrant visa.

  • Relocation: All-in relocation package and Dutch classes for international hires. Eligible hires may qualify for the 30% ruling.

What else is in it for you

  • Pension plan, company laptop, and home internet reimbursement

  • An extensive in-house training program and an annual learning and development budget

  • An environment that embraces AI, both to speed up your work and to advance our systems

  • Gym reimbursement and sports during working hours: kickboxing, CrossFit, fitness, and soccer

  • Weekly Friday drinks, monthly outings, quarterly sports competitions, and two trips abroad a year

  • Daily breakfast and warm lunch, plus snacks and drinks all day

How we work

We're a team of trading and tech enthusiasts with a flat hierarchy. Have an idea today, and it can ship tomorrow. The best idea wins, whoever it comes from.

This role comes with a high degree of autonomy. You'll own hard problems from the first alert to the long-term fix and solve them your way. We promote reverse leadership, give everyone an equal playing field, and invest in personal and professional development.

Ready to keep a 24/7 trading firm running?

Make your move and apply! You can expect to hear back from us within 5 working days.

Our culture

At our core, we are a team of passionate trading and tech enthusiasts committed to revolutionizing trading through automation. Our collaborative approach ensures that everyone contributes to achieving our ambitious goals.

In this role, you will be both challenged and stretched, with ample opportunities for growth and development, both within and beyond your main responsibilities.

We invest in our people by offering competitive compensation and benefits, fostering innovation, and celebrating success. Our commitment to personal development transcends traditional norms; we provide an equal playing field, promote reverse leadership, and offer boundless growth opportunities for all our employees.

Join us to unlock your potential and drive innovation in the exciting world of algorithmic trading.

Before a company publishes its annual report, finance teams have to turn financial data into a complete set of statements and disclosures. Balances need to be mapped, figures carried forward and updated, and supporting information brought together into a draft. Auditors then check that the notes match the primary statements, this year reconciles with last year, and every total adds up. Preparing and reviewing those statements takes days of detailed work, and errors can carry through into a published report.

Today, audit teams rely on Financial Statement Suite (FSS) to read statements, run checks, and show reviewers what it found and where, so they can make the call and stand behind it. The opportunity goes beyond reconciliation: helping auditors and financial professionals review drafts, connect figures to supporting evidence, and manage changes through to sign-off.

You'll own what FSS becomes across preparation and review cycles. You'll decide what sits on the teams roadmap and define strategy for this high opportunity area working with engineering, design, audit experts and the firms who use FSS every day.

About DataSnipper

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.

And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way.

 

What impact you will have

  • Own the end-to-end strategy and decisions for our financial statements product, with clear domain ownership

  • Lead product direction in a key area with direct and clear business impact

  • Reimagine how auditors and financial professionals work, making their workflows more defensible

Why it's an exciting challenge

  • Reviewers are sceptical, and they should be. A finding they can't trace is a finding they check again by hand.

  • Statements differ by country, by standard and by firm. FSS has to be right on all of them, not just the ones in front of you this week.

  • Firms use FSS when the stakes are highest. Every change has to make their next busy season better, not riskier.

  • Everyone has a request: firms, sales, partners and engineering. You'll decide which ones the evidence supports, and say no to the rest.

What you'll own

  • The full FS experience: how a team moves through a draft, from the first finding to sign-off

  • Trust in every check: each finding shows what it compared, where the figures came from, and who reviewed it

  • Quality: what "ready to ship" means for each check, and how the team knows a change helps without breaking something else

  • Where FSS goes next: which statement types, standards and markets come first, and why

     

What you'll do

  • Set the plan and make trade-offs explicit, including new checks versus improving the ones customers already rely on

  • Spend time with auditors: watch real reviews, see where they double-check by hand, and turn that into product decisions

  • Work with engineering and audit experts on sets of real statements that every change has to pass

  • Use product data to decide: which findings reviewers accept, reject or ignore, and why

  • Build on Alwin's shared platform capabilities, and raise dependencies with other teams early

  • Help sales and customer success decide which customers and statements FSS is ready for

  • Write clearly: decisions, specs, and requirements so the team can drive forward with clarity and speed

What you'll bring

Must-have:

  • Product management experience on B2B software where getting it right matters: audit, accounting, tax, legal, compliance or financial services

  • A strong business acumen and focus on business impact

  • Experience shipping AI, machine learning or document-processing features, and making their output something people can check

  • Comfort with data: you can read an error analysis, query your own numbers and spot a sample that isn't representative

  • A record of prioritising for a large user base with demanding customers and competing stakeholders both internal and external

  • Enough technical depth to make trade-offs with engineers on accuracy, data and architecture

Strong-to-have:

  • An audit or accounting background, or deep knowledge of financial reporting (IFRS, US GAAP, UK GAAP)

  • Creative mindset thinking beyond how problems are solved today to reimagine a future approach that drive productivity

About myTomorrows 

myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options.   

We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem.   

We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection.   

With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business.  

Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. 

The Opportunity: Senior Engineering Manager

As an Engineering Manager at myTomorrows, you will lead Backend, Frontend, Full Stack and QA engineers building the platforms that help patients find their treatment options.

Our Expanded Access Program (EAP) platform and Clinical Trials (CT) platform connect patients and healthcare professionals with treatments in development and give our BioPharma Partners the tools to run their programs and trials. You’ll shape how these platforms grow, building a high-performing team that ships well-designed, scalable, secure and compliant software, and delivers it on time.

You won’t do it alone. You’ll partner closely with Product, Design, EAP and CT Operations, and our Platform colleagues in DevOps, Security and Data. Together, you’ll turn ambitious company goals into product outcomes that make a real difference in patients’ lives.

Given that most of our team is located in the Netherlands, we only consider candidates for this position who live within commuting distance of our office in Amsterdam.

What you’ll do in this role:

  • Lead, mentor and manage a team of Backend, Frontend, Full Stack and QA engineers. Foster a collaborative, inclusive and high-performing culture.

  • Own engineering delivery for your areas of the EAP and CT platforms, from discovery through to release and operation in production.

  • Partner with Product Managers and Designers to shape the roadmap, refine priorities, and plan and execute features and improvements.

  • Provide technical leadership in architecture and design, ensuring solutions are robust, maintainable, scalable and secure. Work with engineers on decisions about tools, frameworks and approaches.

  • Champion engineering best practices: proactive exploration AI-enabled and agentic development, code quality, testing, code review, API design, observability, documentation and secure development.

  • Ensure quality and compliance requirements are built into how the team works. This includes data privacy and the regulatory context of healthcare.

  • Build a culture of ownership, experimentation and continuous improvement, including healthy team rituals and retrospectives.

  • Partner with Recruitment to attract, hire and onboard top talent.

What you bring to the table:

  • A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 6+ years of experience in software engineering, with a solid background in backend, frontend or full stack development.

  • 5+ years of experience leading or managing engineering teams.

  • A proven track record of delivering high-quality web products and developing engineers.

  • Hands-on familiarity with modern backend and frontend technologies. Experience with Python and Angular is a plus.

  • A strong understanding of Agile ways of working, product development and engineering best practices.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally and influence stakeholders at all levels.

  • A passion for working in a mission-driven organisation focused on improving patient outcomes.

  • Experience in a regulated domain such as healthcare or life sciences or in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, is a plus.

What success looks like in the first 6 months:

  • You’ve built trust within your team and with Product, Design and Operations, and established clear ownership across your areas of the EAP and CT platforms.

  • Delivery is predictable and transparent. The team ships valuable increments regularly, with a clear link to product goals.

  • Code quality, test coverage and release reliability are visibly improving.

  • Every team member has clear expectations and a development plan, and you’ve addressed any key gaps in team composition.

  • The team works with autonomy and accountability, and collaborates well with Platform and other engineering teams.

  • You’ve identified and started executing key technical or organisational improvements that enhance scalability and team effectiveness.

  • You’re seen as a trusted technical and people leader, balancing strategic direction with hands-on support where needed.

Our current tech stack:

  • We are fully cloud-native on AWS. We follow a lean, API-first product development approach.

  • Our platform services, both microservices and AI, are built in Python.

  • Our frontends are built with Angular.

  • We use GitHub Actions for CI/CD to EKS and Terraform for IaC, with staging/production parity, continuous deployment and Grafana for observability.

  • Security is built in through managed secrets, SSO, dependency scanning, end-to-end encryption and periodic pen-tests.

Equal opportunities

myTomorrows is an Equal Opportunity Employer and, beyond upholding discrimination-free practices, we are committed to cultivating a workplace where difference and diversity are protected and celebrated. The best work comes from our best selves, and we go to great lengths in supporting our team members to be just that.

We believe creativity takes time, but creative production shouldn’t. Since 2016 our mission has been to revolutionize the way creative assets are created and used. Magic happens when we let technology empower creativity. Our endless curiosity and relentless commitment to our customers lies at the heart of our problem-solving approach. This shared mission is woven into our values: we dream big, think differently, and are stronger together.

About the job:

Most of your time goes into backend services, APIs and data models, and you are just as comfortable picking up a Vue.js frontend task when the feature needs it. You don’t hand work over a wall between backend and frontend: you take a feature from the data model to the screen. AI is part of how we build and part of what we build. You use AI coding assistants and agents in your daily work, and you help shape how AI-powered capabilities reach our product. We want people who embrace it, measure what it gives us, and stay in charge of the quality of what ships. Core:

  • Hands-on experience with Vue.js (or another modern frontend framework), and no fear of working in the frontend
  • Solid experience designing and integrating REST and/or GraphQL APIs
  • Proficiency in data modeling and working with SQL and NoSQL databases
  • Comfortable working in monorepo environments and modular architectures
  • Familiar with testing practices, performance tuning and scalable design principles
  • Confident in making architectural decisions and communicating trade-offs
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • You are proactive, result-driven, and excited to work in a fast-growing tech scale-up

What makes you senior for this role:

Nice to have:

  • Experience with PHP (Laravel). Part of our platform runs on it, but it is not what this job is about
